claim_topic: Can masks reduce corona infections when worn by a large proportion of the population?
evidence_text: Claim: Can masks reduce corona infections when worn by a large proportion of the population? | Finding: International studies suggest that the number of corona infections decreases when many people wear masks - whether fabric, surgical or FFP2 masks. However, it is not possible to precisely quantify how great the protective effect actually is. It probably depends on the type of masks and the proportion of people who wear them.

claim_topic: Can homeopathic preparations with Anamirta cocculus help against dizziness?
evidence_text: Claim: Can homeopathic preparations with Anamirta cocculus help against dizziness? | Finding: We have found only one study that has investigated this. However, it is so poor that no reliable statement is possible.

claim_topic: Can zeolite alleviate or prevent health problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Can zeolite alleviate or prevent health problems? | Finding: Studies to date cannot provide any evidence that taking zeolite prevents or alleviates complaints. A detoxifying effect is not scientifically plausible.

claim_topic: Does paxlovid protect unvaccinated people with risk factors from severe or even fatal covid 19 disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Does paxlovid protect unvaccinated people with risk factors from severe or even fatal covid 19 disease? | Finding: In a large, well-done study, paxlovid prevented hospitalizations and deaths in high-risk patients. They were unvaccinated and had contracted the delta variant. For vaccinated people, the benefit cannot be reliably estimated. This also applies to people with immunodeficiency.

claim_topic: Does starting school later improve health, learning success, and quality of life in adolescents?
evidence_text: Claim: Does starting school later improve health, learning success, and quality of life in adolescents? | Finding: The question has been investigated in several large studies. Due to methodological deficiencies and contradictory results, no firm conclusions can be drawn. This means that science can currently neither speak for nor against a benefit of a later school start.

claim_topic: Does the F.X. Mayr cure have health benefits? Can it prevent diseases or treat them?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the F.X. Mayr cure have health benefits? Can it prevent diseases or treat them? | Finding: It is neither examined nor proven whether the special fasting method after F.X. Mayr holds, which it promises: Namely assistance with all possible illnesses of allergies, over rheumatism up to sleep disturbances. The advertised detoxification and "purification" of the body by the chamfering cure are besides scientifically not plausible.

claim_topic: Does the consumption of soy foods or soy isoflavones affect the appearance of acne skin?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the consumption of soy foods or soy isoflavones affect the appearance of acne skin? | Finding: We could not find any meaningful studies at all on the influence of soy foods on acne. On soy isoflavones, we found two small studies of questionable quality that examined a very specific group of sufferers. Soy isoflavones improved the skin appearance somewhat. However, this result is not reliable.

claim_topic: Does extract from the Damiana plant (Turnera diffusa) help with erectile dysfunction?
evidence_text: Claim: Does extract from the Damiana plant (Turnera diffusa) help with erectile dysfunction? | Finding: The extract from the Damiana plant (Turnera diffusa) is advertised as a remedy for erectile dysfunction for men. However, this claimed effect on potency is by no means proven. It has apparently never been tested on humans. This also applies to homeopathic remedies such as the product Neradin.

claim_topic: Is the homeopathic remedy Neradin effective for erectile dysfunction?
evidence_text: Claim: Is the homeopathic remedy Neradin effective for erectile dysfunction? | Finding: The extract from the Damiana plant (Turnera diffusa) is advertised as a remedy for erectile dysfunction for men. However, this claimed effect on potency is by no means proven. It has apparently never been tested on humans. This also applies to homeopathic remedies such as the product Neradin.

claim_topic: Does regular HPV testing in addition to the recommended Pap smear detect more precancerous lesions than just the Pap smear alone?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular HPV testing in addition to the recommended Pap smear detect more precancerous lesions than just the Pap smear alone? | Finding: Regular examination of the cervix by means of PAP smear tests detects precancerous stages of the cervix in most cases in good time. This reduces the risk of developing cervical cancer. An additional HPV test every three to five years can make screening even more reliable. However, the difference should not be too great.

claim_topic: Can monk's pepper reduce PMS symptoms? PMS is the abbreviation for premenstrual syndrome. This refers to complaints that occur in the days before menstruation.
evidence_text: Claim: Can monk's pepper reduce PMS symptoms? PMS is the abbreviation for premenstrual syndrome. This refers to complaints that occur in the days before menstruation. | Finding: In the studies to date, monk's pepper seems to relieve PMS symptoms better than a placebo. However, this is not well proven, because the studies have significant weaknesses. There is no evidence of an effect on menstrual disorders. Significant studies are lacking.

claim_topic: Can olive leaf extract reduce high blood pressure?
evidence_text: Claim: Can olive leaf extract reduce high blood pressure? | Finding: Whether olive leaf extract lowers blood pressure has been investigated in five suitable studies to date. They all found no effect or only a slight effect of the extract. The problem with this is that most of the study participants had only slightly elevated blood pressure. They cannot answer how olive leaf extract works in people with significantly elevated blood pressure (hypertension). The studies also had gross flaws, few participants, and ran for a very short time. They cannot provide reliable answers.

claim_topic: Do green-lipped mussel preparations improve the symptoms of osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Do green-lipped mussel preparations improve the symptoms of osteoarthritis? | Finding: The question was examined in four small studies with serious methodological deficiencies, which also arrived at partly contradictory results. No clear conclusions can be drawn from them. The claim that green-lipped mussel helps with osteoarthritis is not scientifically proven.

claim_topic: Can probiotics lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes?
evidence_text: Claim: Can probiotics lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes? | Finding: The summarized results of studies to date suggest that probiotics in capsule or tablet form could lower blood sugar somewhat. At least if they are taken over a period of two to three months. However, the effect is not well established. Probiotic dairy products and probiotic powder for dissolving do not seem to have any demonstrable effect.

claim_topic: Can the so-called Tupler technique help against rectus diastasis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the so-called Tupler technique help against rectus diastasis? | Finding: We could not find a single study that examined whether the Tupler technique actually works. And this despite the fact that providers of the method advertise that its effectiveness is scientifically proven.

claim_topic: Can CBD (cannabidiol) help with migraines or other headaches?
evidence_text: Claim: Can CBD (cannabidiol) help with migraines or other headaches? | Finding: There are no studies that have investigated the effectiveness of CBD against migraine. So claims that CBD can help with or prevent migraine attacks have no scientific basis. The same is true for other types of headache.

claim_topic: Can laser irradiation of blood by infusion needle (hemolaser treatment) relieve discomfort or help with diseases?
evidence_text: Claim: Can laser irradiation of blood by infusion needle (hemolaser treatment) relieve discomfort or help with diseases? | Finding: There is no scientific evidence that hemolaser treatment has a palliative or curative effect on health problems.

claim_topic: In everyday life, when breathing with an FFP2 mask or ordinary mouth-nose protection, do you get as much oxygen as without a mask?
evidence_text: Claim: In everyday life, when breathing with an FFP2 mask or ordinary mouth-nose protection, do you get as much oxygen as without a mask? | Finding: Even if breathing with a mask can feel uncomfortable: According to studies to date, you get just as much oxygen with an FFP2 mask or mouth-nose protection as without a mask. This is true even when you are moving or exerting yourself. Only very intensive sports slightly reduce the oxygen content in the blood - but too little to endanger health.

claim_topic: Can CBD help with period pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Can CBD help with period pain? | Finding: Whether CBD can relieve menstrual pain has apparently never been scientifically studied. We could not find any studies on this. Women who suffer from severe period pain should talk to a gynecologist about it. Diseases such as endometriosis could be behind it.

claim_topic: Can a bioresonance device like "Bioscan" or "Vieva Vital Analyser" measure mineral and vitamin deficiencies or detect health problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a bioresonance device like "Bioscan" or "Vieva Vital Analyser" measure mineral and vitamin deficiencies or detect health problems? | Finding: An experiment shows that the devices cannot distinguish between healthy people, seriously ill people and a corpse. The claimed mode of action behind the measurement method is also scientifically implausible. A German court has convicted the manufacturers of the Bioscan device (not legally binding) of fraud.

claim_topic: Does arthroscopy (joint endoscopy) help with osteoarthritis of the knee joint?
evidence_text: Claim: Does arthroscopy (joint endoscopy) help with osteoarthritis of the knee joint? | Finding: The data are clear: Arthroscopy is useless as a treatment for knee osteoarthritis. It can neither relieve pain nor improve the function of the knee joint in the long term.

claim_topic: Do dietary supplements containing silicon (e.g. as "organic silicon" or silica) have health benefits?
evidence_text: Claim: Do dietary supplements containing silicon (e.g. as "organic silicon" or silica) have health benefits? | Finding: There is no evidence so far that the additional intake of silicon can promote health. Also that it strengthens nails, skin and hair is an unsubstantiated claim. Moreover, it is unclear whether silicon plays any role at all in the body.

claim_topic: Can regular intake of cranberry juice or cranberry extract prevent recurrent cystitis in women?
evidence_text: Claim: Can regular intake of cranberry juice or cranberry extract prevent recurrent cystitis in women? | Finding: Women who repeatedly have to deal with bladder infections might become ill somewhat less frequently if they regularly take cranberry juice or extract. However, this is not well established. And it only applies to uncomplicated bladder infections in otherwise healthy women. Whether cranberry products help when cystitis is already present remains unclear. This has not yet been investigated in meaningful studies.

claim_topic: Will women who have recurrent bladder infections get rid of them faster if they take cranberry products only after the disease is already there???
evidence_text: Claim: Will women who have recurrent bladder infections get rid of them faster if they take cranberry products only after the disease is already there??? | Finding: Women who repeatedly have to deal with bladder infections might become ill somewhat less frequently if they regularly take cranberry juice or extract. However, this is not well established. And it only applies to uncomplicated bladder infections in otherwise healthy women. Whether cranberry products help when cystitis is already present remains unclear. This has not yet been investigated in meaningful studies.

claim_topic: Can extract from St. John's wort relieve the symptoms of depression? Is it similarly effective as drugs against depression (antidepressants)?
evidence_text: Claim: Can extract from St. John's wort relieve the symptoms of depression? Is it similarly effective as drugs against depression (antidepressants)? | Finding: St. John's wort is likely to relieve the symptoms of mild to moderate depression better than a placebo. It also appears to be similarly effective to approved medications for depression (antidepressants). St. John's wort preparations are generally better tolerated than antidepressants.

claim_topic: Does the Zisano bracelet strengthen the immune system, increase endurance and performance or reduce fatigue?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the Zisano bracelet strengthen the immune system, increase endurance and performance or reduce fatigue? | Finding: The promised positive effects of the "Powerband" wristband on health and well-being have apparently not been scientifically studied. We could not find any studies on this. It is also unclear how the wristband is supposed to work in concrete terms. A scientifically plausible explanation is missing.

claim_topic: Does microimmunotherapy improve symptoms of allergies, cancer, joint inflammation, autoimmune diseases, dementia or various viral infections?
evidence_text: Claim: Does microimmunotherapy improve symptoms of allergies, cancer, joint inflammation, autoimmune diseases, dementia or various viral infections? | Finding: So far, studies seem to exist only on microimmunotherapy against hay fever and cancer. Their significance is far too low to conclude that the therapy is effective. We found no studies on other health problems. Thus, there is no proven benefit of microimmunotherapy for any disease.

claim_topic: Can ginkgo extract improve mental performance in dementia patients?
evidence_text: Claim: Can ginkgo extract improve mental performance in dementia patients? | Finding: Previous studies suggest that ginkgo extract can improve mental performance in dementia - but this is not well established. It is not possible to say exactly how large this effect is.

claim_topic: Does pine wood improve sleep?
evidence_text: Claim: Does pine wood improve sleep? | Finding: So far, only one small study has investigated this question. However, the results of this study are not conclusive due to numerous deficiencies in the conduct of the study.

claim_topic: Do spermidine supplements or a spermidine-rich diet reduce the risk of Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia? Do they help with existing dementia?
evidence_text: Claim: Do spermidine supplements or a spermidine-rich diet reduce the risk of Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia? Do they help with existing dementia? | Finding: Manufacturers of spermidine drugs advertise an alleged positive effect on mental performance and protection against dementia. However, such an effect has not been proven in meaningful studies. We found a single study in which dementia patients had participated. However, their results are not very clear.

claim_topic: Do green-lipped mussel preparations improve the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Do green-lipped mussel preparations improve the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis? | Finding: Five small studies provide no overall evidence of benefit from green-lipped mussel in rheumatism. However, the rheumatism treatment of the participants does not meet today's standards and the studies were very poorly conducted. Therefore, we cannot draw any reliable conclusions from these studies.

claim_topic: Does covid vaccination reduce the likelihood of getting long-lasting symptoms (long covid) in case of corona infection?
evidence_text: Claim: Does covid vaccination reduce the likelihood of getting long-lasting symptoms (long covid) in case of corona infection? | Finding: If twice-vaccinated people are infected, their risk of later being affected by Long Covid may be only half that of non-vaccinated people. Since there is no clear definition of long covid, the protective effect cannot be precisely quantified.

claim_topic: Can the preventive intake of lysine prevent cold sores (lip herpes) and genital herpes? Can lysine help when the blisters are already there?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the preventive intake of lysine prevent cold sores (lip herpes) and genital herpes? Can lysine help when the blisters are already there? | Finding: Research is coming up with inconclusive and contradictory results. All available studies are small and of unclear quality. We could not say whether lysine protects against herpes or can alleviate it.

claim_topic: Do hormonal contraceptives to swallow (the "pill") affect endurance performance in women?
evidence_text: Claim: Do hormonal contraceptives to swallow (the "pill") affect endurance performance in women? | Finding: Taking the pill could possibly impair endurance performance in sports somewhat. However, there are no indications of less muscle strength due to the pill. However, these - somewhat contradictory - findings are anything but certain. Whether the somewhat reduced endurance performance speaks against contraception with the pill, each athlete must decide for herself - depending on how important top athletic performance is for her.

claim_topic: Does the pill affect the muscle strength of women??
evidence_text: Claim: Does the pill affect the muscle strength of women?? | Finding: Taking the pill could possibly impair endurance performance in sports somewhat. However, there are no indications of less muscle strength due to the pill. However, these - somewhat contradictory - findings are anything but certain. Whether the somewhat reduced endurance performance speaks against contraception with the pill, each athlete must decide for herself - depending on how important top athletic performance is for her.

claim_topic: Does whole-body cryotherapy in the cold chamber improve health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does whole-body cryotherapy in the cold chamber improve health? | Finding: Studies published so far are of low quality and therefore not conclusive. The effectiveness of the cold chamber has not been proven for either physical or psychological complaints. There is also no evidence of effectiveness in sports, for example for sore muscles or for a hoped-for increase in athletic performance.

claim_topic: Does transcranial pulse stimulation (TPS) improve mental performance in people with Alzheimer's dementia? Can the treatment improve the quality of life of those affected?
evidence_text: Claim: Does transcranial pulse stimulation (TPS) improve mental performance in people with Alzheimer's dementia? Can the treatment improve the quality of life of those affected? | Finding: Whether transcranial pulse stimulation can help people with Alzheimer's dementia has not yet been investigated in meaningful studies. Possible harmful effects have also been insufficiently researched.

claim_topic: Can low-level laser therapy reduce pain from knee or hip osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can low-level laser therapy reduce pain from knee or hip osteoarthritis? | Finding: In the pain treatment of wrist osteoarthritis, no efficacy can be assumed - this is indicated by the results of a small but well-done study. Research results on knee osteoarthritis are contradictory and therefore of little significance. We did not find any reliable studies on hip osteoarthritis.

claim_topic: Can low-level laser therapy reduce wrist osteoarthritis pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Can low-level laser therapy reduce wrist osteoarthritis pain? | Finding: In the pain treatment of wrist osteoarthritis, no efficacy can be assumed - this is indicated by the results of a small but well-done study. Research results on knee osteoarthritis are contradictory and therefore of little significance. We did not find any reliable studies on hip osteoarthritis.

claim_topic: Does blood type affect the likelihood that Covid 19 disease will take a severe course or lead to death?
evidence_text: Claim: Does blood type affect the likelihood that Covid 19 disease will take a severe course or lead to death? | Finding: There is no reliable evidence that people with a certain blood group are more severely affected by covid-19 than those with another. Study results on this are poorly substantiated and partly contradictory.

claim_topic: Do mouth rinses with hydroxyapatite, for example the products "Linola sept mouth rinse" and "Karex Abwehr", protect against SARS-CoV-2 infection?
evidence_text: Claim: Do mouth rinses with hydroxyapatite, for example the products "Linola sept mouth rinse" and "Karex Abwehr", protect against SARS-CoV-2 infection? | Finding: There are no studies on the anti-corona effect of hydroxyapatite-containing mouth rinses such as "Linola sept" or "Karex Abwehr". We found no studies on the products themselves or on the alleged active ingredient hydroxyapatite. The claimed mechanism of action is not plausible.

claim_topic: Does CBD (cannabidiol) relieve symptoms of mild to moderate covid-19 disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Does CBD (cannabidiol) relieve symptoms of mild to moderate covid-19 disease? | Finding: CBD is unlikely to have any effect on the symptoms of covid-19 disease. This is the conclusion of the only study that has investigated this. However, its validity is somewhat limited due to the small number of participants. Not explored is a possible preventive effect. It is unclear whether CBD or other cannabis constituents - ingested or smoked - protect against corona infection or covid-19 disease.

claim_topic: Does CBD or cannabis use protect against covid-19 disease???
evidence_text: Claim: Does CBD or cannabis use protect against covid-19 disease??? | Finding: CBD is unlikely to have any effect on the symptoms of covid-19 disease. This is the conclusion of the only study that has investigated this. However, its validity is somewhat limited due to the small number of participants. Not explored is a possible preventive effect. It is unclear whether CBD or other cannabis constituents - ingested or smoked - protect against corona infection or covid-19 disease.

claim_topic: Do sedatives and sleeping pills such as benzodiazepines and related substances increase the risk of Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia?
evidence_text: Claim: Do sedatives and sleeping pills such as benzodiazepines and related substances increase the risk of Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia? | Finding: A link between the long-term use of sedatives and sleeping pills and the development of dementia cannot be ruled out. However, whether the drugs are the cause of dementia is unclear. Likewise, it is possible that studies show a connection only because people in the undiagnosed early stages of dementia suffer more frequently from sleep disorders or restlessness and therefore take medication against them more often.

claim_topic: Does taking polyunsaturated fatty acids, such as omega-3 and omega-6, reduce ADHD symptoms in children?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking polyunsaturated fatty acids, such as omega-3 and omega-6, reduce ADHD symptoms in children? | Finding: Studies to date suggest that supplements containing polyunsaturated fatty acids (for example, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids) tend not to have a noticeable effect on attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, the quality of the studies is not sufficient to provide definitive answers.

claim_topic: Do infusions of vitamin C relieve symptoms of chronic fatigue or long covid?
evidence_text: Claim: Do infusions of vitamin C relieve symptoms of chronic fatigue or long covid? | Finding: Whether vitamin C infusions help with chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) is questionable. This has not yet been scientifically investigated. We also could not find a single study on vitamin C and fatigue occurring in the context of Long Covid.

claim_topic: Does taking probiotics shorten the duration of acute infectious diarrhea?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking probiotics shorten the duration of acute infectious diarrhea? | Finding: According to current studies, the duration of disease cannot be reduced by taking probiotics. This assessment is reasonably well supported.

claim_topic: Does high-dose vitamin D slow down the course of disease in multiple sclerosis (MS)?
evidence_text: Claim: Does high-dose vitamin D slow down the course of disease in multiple sclerosis (MS)? | Finding: We can neither clearly exclude nor confirm that there is an effect. In a total of 15 studies, no benefit could be demonstrated for high-dose vitamin D in adults with multiple sclerosis. Because the studies had many weaknesses, we cannot draw any conclusions about positive or negative effects.

claim_topic: Does taking taiga root extract strengthen the immune system? Can it make vaccinations more effective or tolerable?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking taiga root extract strengthen the immune system? Can it make vaccinations more effective or tolerable? | Finding: The alleged immune-strengthening effect of taiga root (also called Siberian ginseng) has apparently never been investigated in appropriate studies. The positive effect claimed by dietary supplement manufacturers after vaccinations is also not proven.

claim_topic: Can ozone therapy, in which autologous blood is treated with ozone and recycled, favorably influence the course of COVID-19 disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Can ozone therapy, in which autologous blood is treated with ozone and recycled, favorably influence the course of COVID-19 disease? | Finding: The few studies on this subject have gross deficiencies and are therefore not conclusive. Their results do not provide any evidence of efficacy of ozone therapy.

claim_topic: Does dimenhydrinate relieve travel nausea better than a placebo?
evidence_text: Claim: Does dimenhydrinate relieve travel nausea better than a placebo? | Finding: The best available studies on the subject are unfortunately not conclusive, for example because they were quite small and the publications lack many details for traceability.  Therefore, we can neither prove nor exclude an effect.

claim_topic: Does dimenhydrinate relieve travel nausea as well as the proven drug scopolamine???
evidence_text: Claim: Does dimenhydrinate relieve travel nausea as well as the proven drug scopolamine??? | Finding: The best available studies on the subject are unfortunately not conclusive, for example because they were quite small and the publications lack many details for traceability.  Therefore, we can neither prove nor exclude an effect.

claim_topic: Does short-term fasting improve quality of life in cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does short-term fasting improve quality of life in cancer? | Finding: We found only three very small studies on both questions. Their results are so unreliable that we cannot make any assessment. So we cannot say whether the quality of life of those affected is improved and whether fasting during chemotherapy reduces side effects.

claim_topic: Does short-term fasting reduce the side effects of chemotherapy for cancer???
evidence_text: Claim: Does short-term fasting reduce the side effects of chemotherapy for cancer??? | Finding: We found only three very small studies on both questions. Their results are so unreliable that we cannot make any assessment. So we cannot say whether the quality of life of those affected is improved and whether fasting during chemotherapy reduces side effects.

claim_topic: Are extracts of Artemisa annua (annual mugwort) or the active ingredient artemisinin obtained from it effective against coronavirus?
evidence_text: Claim: Are extracts of Artemisa annua (annual mugwort) or the active ingredient artemisinin obtained from it effective against coronavirus? | Finding: To date, only one study can be found that investigated Artemisia treatment in mild covid-19 progression. However, due to numerous shortcomings, the results are not conclusive. It has not been studied whether Artemisia helps or prevents severe covid 19 disease or whether the plant can prevent coronavirus infection.

claim_topic: Can zinc mitigate the progression of Covid-19?
evidence_text: Claim: Can zinc mitigate the progression of Covid-19? | Finding: The results of two studies on this suggest that sufferers with Covid-19 do not recover more quickly with zinc than without. A preventive effect has not yet been investigated in studies.

claim_topic: Does zinc preventively protect against covid-19 disease???
evidence_text: Claim: Does zinc preventively protect against covid-19 disease??? | Finding: The results of two studies on this suggest that sufferers with Covid-19 do not recover more quickly with zinc than without. A preventive effect has not yet been investigated in studies.

claim_topic: Does a cold spray with trypsin protect against colds or covid-19? Does the spray reduce symptoms and duration of illness?
evidence_text: Claim: Does a cold spray with trypsin protect against colds or covid-19? Does the spray reduce symptoms and duration of illness? | Finding: The question was investigated in two small studies with gross deficiencies. They cannot prove that treatment with the cold spray relieves symptoms or shortens the duration of illness. Whether the spray has a preventive effect has not been researched for either colds or Covid-19.

claim_topic: Does injecting low-dose Corona vaccine into the skin (mesotherapy vaccination, microvaccination) protect against Covid-19 as well as proven full-dose vaccination into muscle?
evidence_text: Claim: Does injecting low-dose Corona vaccine into the skin (mesotherapy vaccination, microvaccination) protect against Covid-19 as well as proven full-dose vaccination into muscle? | Finding: Some doctors offer corona vaccination using the so-called mesotherapeutic method. Here, vaccination is administered into the skin instead of into the upper arm muscle, with a fraction of the tested and approved dose. Such applications have not been explored for the Corona vaccines. Effective protection against Covid-19 is not assured.

claim_topic: Do herbal remedies with nasturtium and horseradish (Kren) prevent recurrent cystitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Do herbal remedies with nasturtium and horseradish (Kren) prevent recurrent cystitis? | Finding: As for prevention, we have found only one small but somewhat reliable study. According to this, nasturtium-horseradish remedies probably cannot prevent cystitis. For the treatment of cystitis, we were also only able to evaluate one study. However, it leaves too many questions unanswered to be able to clearly assess its effectiveness.

claim_topic: Do herbal remedies with nasturtium and horseradish alleviate the symptoms of cystitis as well as an antibiotic???
evidence_text: Claim: Do herbal remedies with nasturtium and horseradish alleviate the symptoms of cystitis as well as an antibiotic??? | Finding: As for prevention, we have found only one small but somewhat reliable study. According to this, nasturtium-horseradish remedies probably cannot prevent cystitis. For the treatment of cystitis, we were also only able to evaluate one study. However, it leaves too many questions unanswered to be able to clearly assess its effectiveness.

claim_topic: Does mistletoe therapy help against cancer or can it improve the quality of life of cancer patients?
evidence_text: Claim: Does mistletoe therapy help against cancer or can it improve the quality of life of cancer patients? | Finding: Mistletoe therapy for cancer has been investigated in some studies. However, these are very poor and come to inconsistent results. They cannot prove that mistletoe therapy is effective. In addition, there is a suspicion that mistletoe preparations may even stimulate tumor growth in some types of cancer.

claim_topic: Can homeopathic remedies prevent colds in children?
evidence_text: Claim: Can homeopathic remedies prevent colds in children? | Finding: Well-conducted studies find neither a preventive nor an alleviating effect of homeopathy on children's colds (chills). However, these studies have examined too few children for a truly conclusive result. Larger studies would be needed for a clear answer.  It is not scientifically plausible that homeopathic remedies are effective.

claim_topic: Can homeopathic remedies relieve colds in children??
evidence_text: Claim: Can homeopathic remedies relieve colds in children?? | Finding: Well-done studies find neither a preventive nor an alleviating effect of homeopathy on children's colds (chills). However, these studies have examined too few children for a truly conclusive result. Larger studies would be needed for a clear answer.  It is not scientifically plausible that homeopathic remedies are effective.

claim_topic: Do agents containing uridine and/or cytidine improve the symptoms of polyneuropathy?
evidence_text: Claim: Do agents containing uridine and/or cytidine improve the symptoms of polyneuropathy? | Finding: We have not been able to find any meaningful studies on this question.

claim_topic: Can treatments with ultrasound relieve the pain of osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can treatments with ultrasound relieve the pain of osteoarthritis? | Finding: A number of studies have investigated whether ultrasound can help with osteoarthritis of the knee joints. However, their results are not conclusive; the study results are too contradictory to make a definite statement. For osteoarthritis of the hip or hands, this has not been investigated at all.

claim_topic: Does regular exercise reduce the severity and duration of colds and other respiratory infections?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular exercise reduce the severity and duration of colds and other respiratory infections? | Finding: Previous studies suggest that sports-playing people may be just as likely to have respiratory infections as sports-muffle people. However, the illnesses are likely to be somewhat less severe and a bit shorter overall.

claim_topic: Can regular exercise prevent you from getting a cold or other respiratory infections???
evidence_text: Claim: Can regular exercise prevent you from getting a cold or other respiratory infections??? | Finding: Previous studies suggest that sports-playing people may be just as likely to have respiratory infections as sports-muffle people. However, the illnesses are likely to be somewhat less severe and a bit shorter overall.

claim_topic: Can cold showers, cold baths or cold water treading according to Kneipp prevent colds and respiratory infections in adults?
evidence_text: Claim: Can cold showers, cold baths or cold water treading according to Kneipp prevent colds and respiratory infections in adults? | Finding: The three studies conducted to date are too deficient to answer this question.

claim_topic: Can the Wim Hof method - consisting of breathing training, meditation and acclimatization to cold - strengthen the immune system of healthy people and thus prevent infectious diseases?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the Wim Hof method - consisting of breathing training, meditation and acclimatization to cold - strengthen the immune system of healthy people and thus prevent infectious diseases? | Finding: There are individual small studies on the Wim Hof method, but they are poor and inconclusive. Whether the method reduces the probability of infectious diseases has never been researched.

claim_topic: Do saw palmetto preparations improve the symptoms of benign enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia) in the longer term compared to placebo?
evidence_text: Claim: Do saw palmetto preparations improve the symptoms of benign enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia) in the longer term compared to placebo? | Finding: According to current studies, remedies with saw palmetto do not improve the symptoms of a benign enlarged prostate in the longer term more than a placebo. This assessment is well supported.

claim_topic: Does honey help against acute cough in children?
evidence_text: Claim: Does honey help against acute cough in children? | Finding: Honey should help children with acute cough: The coughing attacks are likely to become somewhat less frequent, weaker and less distressing. Children's and parents' sleep may also improve, and the time to resolution is likely to be a little shorter. However, the effects achieved are only small.

claim_topic: Can Artemisia tea cure malaria as well as drugs?
evidence_text: Claim: Can Artemisia tea cure malaria as well as drugs? | Finding: Four studies with a total of relatively few participants come to contradictory results. Since all studies have problems, we cannot draw any meaningful conclusions about the healing success - i.e., we can neither confirm nor exclude a positive lasting effect.

claim_topic: Does thyme help against cough?
evidence_text: Claim: Does thyme help against cough? | Finding: Whether thyme is effective against cough has not yet been researched in meaningful studies.

claim_topic: Does coenzyme Q10 relieve muscle discomfort during treatment with statins?
evidence_text: Claim: Does coenzyme Q10 relieve muscle discomfort during treatment with statins? | Finding: Several studies come to contradictory results. In addition, the range of variation in the estimated effect is very large, and the individual studies have certain shortcomings. On this basis, no firm conclusions can be drawn.

claim_topic: Does Chaga mushroom help against cancer or other diseases?

claim_topic: Do remedies with ginseng help with erectile dysfunction?

claim_topic: Does vitamin D alleviate autism symptoms in children?

claim_topic: Does glutathione improve the tolerability of chemotherapy for cancer?

claim_topic: Does carnosine relieve autism symptoms in children?

claim_topic: Can echinacea protect against Sars-CoV-2 infection or help treat covid-19?

claim_topic: Does amygdalin, the toxin from the seeds of apricots and other stone fruits, help against cancer?

claim_topic: Can ginkgo extract relieve the symptoms of tinnitus?
evidence_text: Claim: Can ginkgo extract relieve the symptoms of tinnitus? | Finding: Preparations with ginkgo extract cannot help with tinnitus. evidence_text: Claim: Do remedies with ginkgo help against tinnitus in people with dementia? | Finding: The efficacy of ginkgo against tinnitus in dementia patients has been co-tested in a few studies. claim_topic: Does garlic protect against corona infections?

claim_topic: Is whole-body vibration therapy effective in preventing bone fractures in osteoporosis sufferers?
evidence_text: Claim: Is whole-body vibration therapy effective in preventing bone fractures in osteoporosis sufferers? | Finding: We did not find any studies that investigated whether vibration training affects the risk of bone fractures in people with osteoporosis. claim_topic: Does denosumab (Prolia) reduce the risk of vertebral fractures in osteoporosis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does denosumab (Prolia) reduce the risk of vertebral fractures in osteoporosis? | Finding: The pooled results of studies to date show that denosumab reduces the risk of vertebral fractures more than a placebo. It may even be slightly more protective than single other osteoporosis drugs.  It cannot be ruled out that discontinuing denosumab increases the likelihood of vertebral fractures again. The studies on this are contradictory.

claim_topic: Does taking magnesium improve the symptoms of depression?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking magnesium improve the symptoms of depression? | Finding: The question has been investigated in only three small studies. These had several shortcomings and in some cases reached contradictory results.

claim_topic: Does focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatment reduce wrinkles and sagging of the skin?
evidence_text: Claim: Does focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatment reduce wrinkles and sagging of the skin? | Finding: We did not find any conclusive studies. So whether HIFU has a visible effect is not solidly studied. However, there are reports of significant pain, redness and swelling.

claim_topic: Does a ketogenic diet help against cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does a ketogenic diet help against cancer? | Finding: To date, there are no well-done studies that have examined the effect of a ketogenic diet on cancer in humans. This involves eating little or no carbohydrates and sugar, but plenty of protein and fat. Experts take a critical view of "cancer diets" such as the ketogenic diet - they can also be dangerous.

claim_topic: Do curd compresses have an analgesic effect (e.g. for muscle and joint pain)? Do they have an antipyretic effect? Do curd compresses help breastfeeding women with lactation congestion?
evidence_text: Claim: Do curd compresses have an analgesic effect (e.g. for muscle and joint pain)? Do they have an antipyretic effect? Do curd compresses help breastfeeding women with lactation congestion? | Finding: We could not find any conclusive studies on curd wraps. Whether the effect goes beyond a cooling effect is unclear.

claim_topic: Does deuterium-reduced water prevent cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does deuterium-reduced water prevent cancer? | Finding: We found only one study with prostate cancer patients comparing deuterium-reduced water with normal water. This small study has numerous flaws, so the results are not conclusive. We were unable to locate reliable studies on its use in other cancers or for cancer prevention.

claim_topic: Does deuterium-reduced water improve disease progression in cancer???
evidence_text: Claim: Does deuterium-reduced water improve disease progression in cancer??? | Finding: We found only one study with prostate cancer patients comparing deuterium-reduced water with normal water. This small study has numerous flaws, so the results are not conclusive. We were unable to locate reliable studies on its use in other cancers or for cancer prevention.

claim_topic: Can a special mattress relieve nighttime rheumatism symptoms and thus improve sleep?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a special mattress relieve nighttime rheumatism symptoms and thus improve sleep? | Finding: During our research, we did not find any scientific studies on this. Therefore, we can not make any statement about the effect of special mattresses.

claim_topic: Do people with blood group AB have a higher risk of developing dementia?
evidence_text: Claim: Do people with blood group AB have a higher risk of developing dementia? | Finding: The risk of dementia appears to be similar for people of all four blood groups (A, B, AB, 0). This was shown by two studies that evaluated data from more than 9,000 affected individuals. The claim spread in the media that the AB blood group increases the risk of dementia is therefore unlikely to be true.

claim_topic: Does therapeutic dancing help people with Parkinson's improve their movement problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Does therapeutic dancing help people with Parkinson's improve their movement problems? | Finding: Dancing could somewhat improve the movement problems of affected people. It is also possible that dancing performs slightly better compared to other movement exercises. Nevertheless, it does not seem to increase the quality of life noticeably.

claim_topic: Is it possible to reliably detect coronavirus infection based only on symptoms but without laboratory testing?
evidence_text: Claim: Is it possible to reliably detect coronavirus infection based only on symptoms but without laboratory testing? | Finding: So far, no symptoms have emerged from which a covid 19 infection can be inferred with certainty. The absence of certain symptoms also does not allow an all-clear to be given. Thus, it appears that symptoms such as coughing, shortness of breath or loss of smell are not suitable for making a diagnosis. Laboratory tests ("PCR tests") are currently the safest option (as of August 2020).

claim_topic: Are home coronavirus self-tests as reliable as tests performed by trained healthcare professionals?
evidence_text: Claim: Are home coronavirus self-tests as reliable as tests performed by trained healthcare professionals? | Finding: Whether self-tests from the drugstore or pharmacy provide as reliable results as a test by trained health personnel has not yet been investigated. Errors are possible when taking the sample at home. Things can also go wrong in transit to the laboratory. This can affect the accuracy of the test result. But whether done by yourself or by trained personnel, even the best Corona test is not one hundred percent reliable.

claim_topic: Does biotin help with hair loss? Does biotin make hair grow faster?
evidence_text: Claim: Does biotin help with hair loss? Does biotin make hair grow faster? | Finding: The number of studies dealing with the effect of biotin on hair growth is insufficient. According to current research, a positive effect has not been confirmed.

claim_topic: Can induction of labor prevent infant deaths in pregnancies that go beyond the estimated due date? Does it reduce the number of neonatal intensive care unit stays?
evidence_text: Claim: Can induction of labor prevent infant deaths in pregnancies that go beyond the estimated due date? Does it reduce the number of neonatal intensive care unit stays? | Finding: The summary of 34 strong studies involving 21,500 women shows that birth inductions can prevent baby deaths and neonatal intensive care unit stays - compared to observational waiting. Cesarean sections are likely to be needed less often with inductions than with waiting. The use of a suction cup and forceps is unlikely to change much, if at all. The results apply to women with no special risks and in the case that the pregnancy continues beyond the expected delivery date.

claim_topic: Does induction of labor make cesarean sections less necessary than observational waiting?
evidence_text: Claim: Does induction of labor make cesarean sections less necessary than observational waiting? | Finding: The summary of 34 strong studies involving 21,500 women shows that birth inductions can prevent baby deaths and neonatal intensive care unit stays - compared to observational waiting. claim_topic: Does taking supplements with omega-3 fatty acids reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke or other sudden cardiovascular problems?  Does it lower the risk of dying prematurely?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking supplements with omega-3 fatty acids reduce the risk of heart attack, stroke or other sudden cardiovascular problems?  Does it lower the risk of dying prematurely? | Finding: The summarized results of studies to date clearly show that dietary supplements with omega-3 fatty acids do not protect against acute cardiovascular diseases such as heart attack or stroke. The same applies to diets particularly rich in omega-3s.  Additional omega-3 fatty acids also cannot reduce the general risk of premature death.

claim_topic: Can taking dietary supplements with omega-3 fatty acids prevent further heart attacks or strokes if one has already had a heart attack?  In this case, does it lower the risk of dying prematurely??

claim_topic: Can cosmetic products with caffeine for hair and scalp help against hereditary hair loss?
evidence_text: Claim: Can cosmetic products with caffeine for hair and scalp help against hereditary hair loss? | Finding: Caffeine can penetrate the hair root and prolong the hair growth phase there - at least if the hair loss is hereditary (androgenetic alopecia). At least, this is what studies from the laboratory indicate. Whether caffeine shampoo or other cosmetic products containing caffeine help women and men with hereditary hair loss is not yet clear. Reliable research is still lacking.

claim_topic: Is music therapy with rhythmic training helpful for people with Parkinson's who have trouble walking?
evidence_text: Claim: Is music therapy with rhythmic training helpful for people with Parkinson's who have trouble walking? | Finding: Music therapy with rhythmic training could help Parkinson's sufferers walk a little faster and more safely. However, the effect is unlikely to be very great.

claim_topic: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint?
evidence_text: Claim: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint? | Finding: There is evidence of minor efficacy of preparations containing avocado and soybean oil (ASU). They can probably somewhat alleviate movement restrictions and pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint - at least in the short term. An effect in osteoarthritis of the hip joint has not yet been shown. Side effects are not to be expected.

claim_topic: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the hip joint?
evidence_text: Claim: Do preparations with unsaponifiable components of avocado and soybean oils (ASU) help against limitations and pain in osteoarthritis of the hip joint? | Finding: There is evidence of minor efficacy of preparations containing avocado and soybean oil (ASU). claim_topic: Can taking chondroitin relieve osteoarthritis pain or improve mobility in the long term?
evidence_text: Claim: Can taking chondroitin relieve osteoarthritis pain or improve mobility in the long term? | Finding: In the studies conducted to date, chondroitin did not lead to any noticeable overall improvement in the symptoms of osteoarthritis. However, the results differ from one another in some cases. This limits their significance somewhat.

claim_topic: Does taking arginine benefit existing cardiovascular disease or does arginine prevent it from developing?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking arginine benefit existing cardiovascular disease or does arginine prevent it from developing? | Finding: We found only one small study that investigated a benefit that was noticeable for those affected. In patients with heart failure, taking arginine did not improve exercise tolerance or quality of life. Due to a lack of details, we cannot conclusively assess how reliable these results are. Therefore, we cannot make any statements on the benefit of arginine.

claim_topic: Does "Detoxic" work against tapeworms and other parasites? Does "Detoxic" help with health complaints?
evidence_text: Claim: Does "Detoxic" work against tapeworms and other parasites? Does "Detoxic" help with health complaints? | Finding: There are no published studies on "Detoxic". The claimed effects cannot be verified and seem frivolous.

claim_topic: Is mannose as good as or better than antibiotics for preventing recurrent cystitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Is mannose as good as or better than antibiotics for preventing recurrent cystitis? | Finding: In two studies, bladder infections occurred with a similar frequency or even less frequently with mannose than with an antibiotic. However, the studies are so poorly done that the results are not trustworthy.

claim_topic: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of spinal fractures in older women?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of spinal fractures in older women? | Finding: Taking vitamin K probably does not reduce the risk of vertebral fractures. However, this assessment is not well supported. The risk of other bone fractures could possibly be reduced - but only slightly. This estimate is also subject to some uncertainty.

claim_topic: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of other bone fractures in older women?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking vitamin K lower the risk of other bone fractures in older women? | Finding: Taking vitamin K probably does not reduce the risk of vertebral fractures. However, this assessment is not well supported. The risk of other bone fractures could possibly be reduced - but only slightly. This estimate is also subject to some uncertainty.

claim_topic: Does Smartsleep provide better or more restful sleep?
evidence_text: Claim: Does Smartsleep provide better or more restful sleep? | Finding: There are no studies on this dietary supplement. Whether Smartsleep has a positive effect on sleep must first be scientifically researched. According to the manufacturer, a clinical study on this is in progress.

claim_topic: Can supplemental tryptophan, taken as a dietary supplement or with food, help with depression?
evidence_text: Claim: Can supplemental tryptophan, taken as a dietary supplement or with food, help with depression? | Finding: The amino acid tryptophan appears again and again as a possible treatment for depression. However, an effect could not be scientifically proven so far. Significant studies on tryptophan against depression are lacking.

claim_topic: Can Neuro-Socks relieve pain or improve balance and stability?
evidence_text: Claim: Can Neuro-Socks relieve pain or improve balance and stability? | Finding: There is no scientific evidence of such an effect.

claim_topic: Does taking blood pressure medication in the evening prevent more heart attacks, strokes, and other acute cardiovascular diseases?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking blood pressure medication in the evening prevent more heart attacks, strokes, and other acute cardiovascular diseases? | Finding: According to two large studies, taking antihypertensive drugs in the evening should significantly reduce the risk of heart attacks, strokes and similar acute cardiovascular diseases compared with taking them in the morning. However, the described effect is on the one hand rather uncertain and on the other hand not very plausible. Therefore, it is not possible to say whether evening intake is actually better. The larger of the two studies will be reviewed again (as of June 2020).

claim_topic: In Covid-19, do nicotine or smoking have a protective effect, i.e., do they prevent severe progression or death?
evidence_text: Claim: In Covid-19, do nicotine or smoking have a protective effect, i.e., do they prevent severe progression or death? | Finding: An observational study from a Paris hospital cited in many media is not suitable to support this hypothesis. On the contrary, according to the current state of knowledge, it is plausible that smokers could have an increased risk with Covid-19. They may be more likely to have a severe course of corona infection, necessitating ventilation or death.

claim_topic: Can red mold rice products lower blood cholesterol levels?
evidence_text: Claim: Can red mold rice products lower blood cholesterol levels? | Finding: Red mold rice naturally contains the substance lovastatin, which acts as a cholesterol-lowering agent. The concentration of lovastatin in products made from red mold rice can vary greatly. Therefore, it is not certain that red mold rice is as effective as drugs containing a controlled amount of lovastatin. Depending on the dosage, undesirable side effects from red mold rice are possible - just as with the "real" drugs.

claim_topic: Do products made from red mold rice have fewer side effects than cholesterol-lowering drugs called statins???

claim_topic: Can disinfectants containing highly diluted sodium hypochlorite (below 0.1%) render corona and other viruses harmless and thus protect against infection?
evidence_text: Claim: Can disinfectants containing highly diluted sodium hypochlorite (below 0.1%) render corona and other viruses harmless and thus protect against infection? | Finding: Whether disinfectants containing sodium hypochlorite reliably rid hands of viruses has never been investigated in scientific studies. However, studies on the disinfection of surfaces suggest: The low concentration of sodium hypochlorite may not be sufficient for reliable disinfection of hands.

claim_topic: Does cat's claw improve joint disease symptoms?
evidence_text: Claim: Does cat's claw improve joint disease symptoms? | Finding: We found three small studies that investigated cat's claw in patients with rheumatoid arthritis or osteoarthritis. The studies have significant flaws and sometimes come to contradictory results. Therefore, the question cannot be answered unequivocally.

claim_topic: Do essential oils protect against corona infections and other viral infections like colds or flu?
evidence_text: Claim: Do essential oils protect against corona infections and other viral infections like colds or flu? | Finding: In laboratory tests, some essential oils can successfully kill viruses. Whether spraying, inhaling or swallowing the oils also protects against infections with viruses such as the Corona virus in real life is unclear. It has not been scientifically studied yet.

claim_topic: Do air purifiers help relieve symptoms of allergic asthma?
evidence_text: Claim: Do air purifiers help relieve symptoms of allergic asthma? | Finding: In our literature search, we found no evidence that air purifiers can help control allergic asthma. According to previous studies, they are unlikely to filter enough allergenic substances from indoor air to relieve symptoms or reduce medication.

claim_topic: Is special baby water better for infants than tap water?
evidence_text: Claim: Is special baby water better for infants than tap water? | Finding: Whether special baby water is healthier for infants than tap water has not been scientifically studied. In principle, however, tap water in Austria is also suitable for babies. Boiling tap water is no longer necessary after the sixth month of life.

claim_topic: Does platelet-rich plasma therapy (autologous blood therapy) reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint?
evidence_text: Claim: Does platelet-rich plasma therapy (autologous blood therapy) reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee joint? | Finding: Injections with platelet-rich plasma could slightly reduce pain in osteoarthritis of the knee. The therapy is apparently more effective than placebo treatment, but the effect is small.  For the hip, on the other hand, studies tend to point toward no efficacy. Local side effects are common. Which form of therapy is best for whom has not yet been clarified, and long-term success has not been studied.

claim_topic: Can vitamin D supplements prevent colds, flu, colds, and other viral respiratory illnesses when there is no or only a mild deficiency of vitamin D?
evidence_text: Claim: Can vitamin D supplements prevent colds, flu, colds, and other viral respiratory illnesses when there is no or only a mild deficiency of vitamin D? | Finding: Taking vitamin D probably has no preventive effect against infections with cold, cold and flu viruses. This is true at least for people with normal or moderately low levels of vitamin D in their blood. If there is a severe deficiency, however, the immune system is likely to benefit from treatment with vitamin D.

claim_topic: Does ACE inhibitors like ramipril increase the risk of lung cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does ACE inhibitors like ramipril increase the risk of lung cancer? | Finding: A large observational study has found an increased risk of lung cancer with long-term use of ACE inhibitors compared with another group of antihypertensive drugs. However, other causes for this association cannot be completely ruled out. Previous studies have reached inconsistent results. Therefore, it can currently neither be confirmed nor ruled out that the risk of lung cancer may increase with ACE inhibitors. Even if further studies should really confirm the increased risk, the effect is likely to be rather small.

claim_topic: Does propolis have a preventive or soothing effect against infection with coronavirus, colds or flu?
evidence_text: Claim: Does propolis have a preventive or soothing effect against infection with coronavirus, colds or flu? | Finding: To date, there are no studies that have investigated the effect of propolis in these viral infections.

claim_topic: Does DAILY administration of HIGH-dose atropine (0.5 - 1%) sustainably inhibit the progression of myopia in children?
evidence_text: Claim: Does DAILY administration of HIGH-dose atropine (0.5 - 1%) sustainably inhibit the progression of myopia in children? | Finding: Drip-feeding high-dose atropine for 1-3 years probably inhibits the progression of myopia in the short term. If dripping is done daily, the effect does not seem to be noticeable 1 year after the end of treatment. If dripping is done monthly at first and then every 2 months, the effect is likely to last longer. Whether lower-dose atropine helps in the long term is poorly understood.
