claim_topic: Is quarantining persons who have had contact with infected persons or who enter from high-risk areas an effective measure to reduce the number of COVID-19 infections and deaths?
evidence_text: Claim: Is quarantining persons who have had contact with infected persons or who enter from high-risk areas an effective measure to reduce the number of COVID-19 infections and deaths? | Finding: The analysis of 29 studies suggests that quarantine can prevent COVID-19 infections and deaths. The validity of the studies to date is diminished by the fact that only mathemathic modeling studies are available for coronavirus. However, observational studies and modeling of the related diseases SARS and MERS show much the same thing: precautionary quarantine of those who may be infected is likely to be effective, especially if the action is taken early. As a stand-alone measure, quarantine is unlikely to be sufficient to sustainably contain the pandemic.

claim_topic: Can homeopathic globules protect against infection with the novel coronavirus?
evidence_text: Claim: Can homeopathic globules protect against infection with the novel coronavirus? | Finding: There is no evidence that globules can protect against the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2). Scientifically, this has never been investigated.  However, studies on other viral diseases, such as the common cold, show: a curative effect of homeopathy has not been proven.

claim_topic: Does the osteoporosis drug teriparatide increase the risk of bone cancer as a side effect?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the osteoporosis drug teriparatide increase the risk of bone cancer as a side effect? | Finding: The suspicion that teriparatide could cause bone cancer as a side effect is based on animal studies on the one hand. On the other hand, there are individual cases of bone cancer in people treated with teriparatide - although a causal relationship cannot be clearly proven here. Systematic studies of people treated with teriparatide could not provide clear results. Since bone cancer is a very rare disease, its risk factors are difficult to pin down in studies.

claim_topic: Can therapy with EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) alleviate the symptoms of people with post-traumatic stress disorder?
evidence_text: Claim: Can therapy with EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) alleviate the symptoms of people with post-traumatic stress disorder? | Finding: Therapy with EMDR is probably more effective than no therapy at all for people suffering from the psychological consequences of a traumatic experience. Its effectiveness may be similar to that of exposure therapy. This is a widely established and well-studied form of psychotherapy.

claim_topic: Does EMDR work similarly to exposure therapy, another well-studied form of psychotherapy for the symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder???
evidence_text: Claim: Does EMDR work similarly to exposure therapy, another well-studied form of psychotherapy for the symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder??? | Finding: Therapy with EMDR is probably more effective than no therapy at all for people suffering from the psychological consequences of a traumatic experience. Its effectiveness may be similar to that of exposure therapy. This is a widely established and well-studied form of psychotherapy.

claim_topic: Does filling with hydrogel help with chronic back pain caused by a worn disc?
evidence_text: Claim: Does filling with hydrogel help with chronic back pain caused by a worn disc? | Finding: None of the studies to date can answer how well the treatment works - they lack conclusiveness for this. Some hydrogel products have since been withdrawn from the market.

claim_topic: Does taking hyaluronic acid in capsule form improve the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking hyaluronic acid in capsule form improve the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis? | Finding: The question was examined in three small studies with various shortcomings. They come to contradictory results. Therefore, we cannot say for sure whether hyaluronic acid for oral use has a beneficial effect on the symptoms of knee osteoarthritis. We are also unable to make any reliable statements about possible risks on the basis of the best available studies.

claim_topic: Does taking chlorella provide better performance, more resilience and does it promote health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking chlorella provide better performance, more resilience and does it promote health? | Finding: We have found only one very small study on this topic with completely unclear results. From this, we cannot derive any statements on the benefits and risks of dietary supplements from chlorella algae.

claim_topic: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong men's lives?
evidence_text: Claim: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong men's lives? | Finding: Men who go to the sauna several times a week live longer than those who go only once a week. However, it is possible that this is not due to the sauna at all. For women, the effect of sauna visits has not been sufficiently researched.

claim_topic: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong women's lives???
evidence_text: Claim: Does going to the sauna several times a week prolong women's lives??? | Finding: Men who go to the sauna several times a week live longer than those who go only once a week. However, it is possible that this is not due to the sauna at all. For women, the effect of sauna visits has not been sufficiently researched.

claim_topic: Does the additional offer of HIV self-testing cause more people to take an HIV test?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the additional offer of HIV self-testing cause more people to take an HIV test? | Finding: Current research provides very strong evidence that the addition of HIV self-testing leads to more people taking an HIV test. Among others, people for whom testing at health facilities by professionals is not acceptable for various reasons also make use of this offer.

claim_topic: Can the combination of propolis, xyloglucan, gelatin and hibiscus (product "Utipro Plus") relieve the symptoms of cystitis or prevent cystitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the combination of propolis, xyloglucan, gelatin and hibiscus (product "Utipro Plus") relieve the symptoms of cystitis or prevent cystitis? | Finding: Three studies on the product "Utipro Plus" investigated the combination of these ingredients. However, statements on the efficacy cannot be made, as the studies have various shortcomings. We did not find any studies on the ingredients - used individually.

claim_topic: Does PEMF noticeably improve pain in osteoarthritis? Does the method improve mobility and quality of life in sufferers?
evidence_text: Claim: Does PEMF noticeably improve pain in osteoarthritis? Does the method improve mobility and quality of life in sufferers? | Finding: Pain was investigated in eight small rather flawed studies. The studies arrived at widely divergent answers. In the studies with positive results, it is partly unclear whether the difference was actually noticeable for those affected. Quality of life and mobility were investigated in five and two studies, respectively - these were small and of little significance. In addition, the studies came to contradictory results.

claim_topic: Does oil pulling promote dental health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does oil pulling promote dental health? | Finding: Studies conducted to date have been poorly done and are not conclusive. Thus, they cannot answer this question.

claim_topic: Can injecting stem cells into the knee joint relieve pain and limitations associated with osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can injecting stem cells into the knee joint relieve pain and limitations associated with osteoarthritis? | Finding: It is unclear whether stem cells injected into the knee for osteoarthritis have a curative effect.  Possible side effects and dangers are also insufficiently researched.

claim_topic: Can an extract of Desmodium promote liver health or relieve other ailments?
evidence_text: Claim: Can an extract of Desmodium promote liver health or relieve other ailments? | Finding: We found no conclusive studies on the efficacy of Desmodium - neither on liver health nor for any other application.

claim_topic: Does the balsam apple help against infection with the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the balsam apple help against infection with the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)? | Finding: Laboratory experiments have tested how proteins from the fruits and seeds of the balsam apple Momordica behave against the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). However, studies with humans are still lacking.

claim_topic: Does healing clay with the clay mineral smectite help when children have diarrhea?
evidence_text: Claim: Does healing clay with the clay mineral smectite help when children have diarrhea? | Finding: Healing clay with smectite could shorten a diarrheal illness in children by about one day. For healing clay with kaolinite or loess, the effectiveness is unclear.

claim_topic: Does a herbal combination preparation of rosemary, lovage, and centaury effectively relieve symptoms of uncomplicated cystitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does a herbal combination preparation of rosemary, lovage, and centaury effectively relieve symptoms of uncomplicated cystitis? | Finding: Laboratory and animal tests indicate that ingredients of rosemary, lovage and millenium wort can relieve inflammation and cramps. The study teams concluded in the publications that the vegetable resource was effective for both purposes. From our point of view, there are cautious indications of a relieving effect in case of acute uncomplicated bladder inflammation [1] – but many questions remain open at the same time.

claim_topic: Can a herbal combination preparation of rosemary, lovage and centaury prevent recurrent cystitis in women?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a herbal combination preparation of rosemary, lovage and centaury prevent recurrent cystitis in women? | Finding: We do not consider a preventive effect to be sufficiently substantiated on the basis of the study available to us [2]. Not meaningful enough The study on the prevention of recurrent bladder inflammation [2] is very small with only 90 participants and has serious deficiencies.

claim_topic: Can healing clay help with gastritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Can healing clay help with gastritis? | Finding: We could not find a meaningful study that scientifically examined this question.

claim_topic: Does the Indian spice paste Chyawanprash have a positive effect on adult health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the Indian spice paste Chyawanprash have a positive effect on adult health? | Finding: There is a lack of conclusive studies on possible health effects of Chyawanprash. We can neither confirm nor deny a beneficial effect.

claim_topic: Does ginger work against breast cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does ginger work against breast cancer? | Finding: So far, only isolated animal studies and experiments with cells indicate that ginger substances could favorably influence the behavior of breast cancer cells. Studies with breast cancer patients are lacking. Therefore, there are no data on the efficacy

claim_topic: Can Theta Healing help with physical ailments and mental problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Can Theta Healing help with physical ailments and mental problems? | Finding: There are no studies that have directly examined the healing effects of Theta Healing. However, one experiment contradicts a basic assumption of the method: According to this, there is no evidence that increased theta brain waves occur in involved persons.

claim_topic: Does taking Bacopa extract improve memory performance?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking Bacopa extract improve memory performance? | Finding: The question was investigated in several mainly properly done studies with more than 500 people. Overall, no significant positive effects on memory and attention were found. Since some of the studies arrived at very different results and the estimates were far apart, this clearly limits the significance of the result.

claim_topic: Do remedies containing the trifoliate fruit alleviate the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis ("rheumatism")?
evidence_text: Claim: Do remedies containing the trifoliate fruit alleviate the symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis ("rheumatism")? | Finding: We have evaluated two small studies. They suggest that taking trifoliate relieves some rheumatism symptoms better than a placebo remedy. However, these results are not well established.

claim_topic: Does thyme strengthen memory or prevent mental decline?
evidence_text: Claim: Does thyme strengthen memory or prevent mental decline? | Finding: We have not been able to find any studies that have examined this question in the context of human studies.

claim_topic: Does regular consumption of chia seeds reduce body weight, blood sugar levels or cholesterol?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular consumption of chia seeds reduce body weight, blood sugar levels or cholesterol? | Finding: Whether Chia seeds promote health has not been directly studied. The summarized results of previous studies at least indicate that Chia has no effect on body weight, blood sugar and cholesterol levels. The significance of this

claim_topic: Do heat patches that heat themselves or heat pads help with pain in the neck?
evidence_text: Claim: Do heat patches that heat themselves or heat pads help with pain in the neck? | Finding: Studies on the pain-relieving effect of heat pads and self-heating plasters are contradictory.

claim_topic: Do heat patches containing capsaicin help with neck pain???
evidence_text: Claim: Do heat patches containing capsaicin help with neck pain??? | Finding: Studies on the pain-relieving effect of heat pads and self-heating plasters are contradictory.

claim_topic: Do heat patches help with lower back pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Do heat patches help with lower back pain? | Finding: Heat patches produce heat by means of a chemical reaction. They can probably relieve low back pain somewhat in the short term. However, this has only been investigated for complaints that have persisted for a maximum of 3 months... Heat patches with chili extract (capsaicin)

claim_topic: Does ginger help with period pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Does ginger help with period pain? | Finding: Previous studies indicate that ginger can slightly relieve menstrual pain. However, due to deficiencies in their conduct, they are of limited value.

claim_topic: Can the state of health be assessed as reliably with a "cell check" analysis as with other diagnostic tests (for example, blood or urine analyses)?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the state of health be assessed as reliably with a "cell check" analysis as with other diagnostic tests (for example, blood or urine analyses)? | Finding: There are no studies in which the reliability and significance of "cell check" results have been verified.

claim_topic: Can pain from osteoarthritis (joint wear) be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel?
evidence_text: Claim: Can pain from osteoarthritis (joint wear) be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel? | Finding: Lubricated joints with hooks We found indications of some effectiveness in the age-related joint wear (arthrosis) in the fingers – in a study [1] with 204 people affected. However, it cannot be derived from how small or large the analgesic effect of Arnika-Gel is for application.

claim_topic: Can pain from a sprained ankle be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel?
evidence_text: Claim: Can pain from a sprained ankle be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel? | Finding: No confidence in sprains We found a study [2] in which an arnica spray was compared with an active placebo spray to sprained ankles. However, we do not consider the study to be trustworthy, because it is rather inaccurate. In addition, important data are missing. We cannot, therefore, say whether Arnika helps in spraining the ankle. Arnika ineffective against sore muscles?

claim_topic: Can sore muscles be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel?
evidence_text: Claim: Can sore muscles be relieved by arnica ointment or arnica gel? | Finding: Arnika ineffective against sore muscles? There was no noticeable pain-relieving effect in any of them. Since the studies together only had 93 participants, this is not a meaningful result. We cannot therefore safely assume that arnica gels or ointments are really ineffective in case of muscle ache.

claim_topic: Can carbon dioxide in mineral water and other sparkling drinks damage teeth or cause tooth decay?
evidence_text: Claim: Can carbon dioxide in mineral water and other sparkling drinks damage teeth or cause tooth decay? | Finding: Whether the regular consumption of carbonated beverages (mineral water, sparkling soft drinks) damages the teeth more than non-carbonated beverages has not yet been researched.

claim_topic: Does bark extract from maritime pine (also: "pine bark extract") improve the symptoms of osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does bark extract from maritime pine (also: "pine bark extract") improve the symptoms of osteoarthritis? | Finding: The question was investigated in three smaller studies. However, due to severe methodological deficiencies and partly contradictory results, no firm conclusions can be drawn from them.

claim_topic: Is brown millet effective in favorably influencing the course of the disease in rheumatism ("rheumatoid arthritis")?
evidence_text: Claim: Is brown millet effective in favorably influencing the course of the disease in rheumatism ("rheumatoid arthritis")? | Finding: We could not find any studies on this topic; therefore, statements on the benefits and risks of brown millet in rheumatoid arthritis are not possible.

claim_topic: Are cannabis or substances derived from cannabis effective and safe anti-cancer agents?
evidence_text: Claim: Are cannabis or substances derived from cannabis effective and safe anti-cancer agents? | Finding: Reliable studies on this question are lacking.

claim_topic: It is not always possible to reduce elevated cholesterol levels to a healthy level with tablets and thus minimize the risk of heart attack or stroke. Does this succeed through additional injections with PCSK9 antibodies?
evidence_text: Claim: It is not always possible to reduce elevated cholesterol levels to a healthy level with tablets and thus minimize the risk of heart attack or stroke. Does this succeed through additional injections with PCSK9 antibodies? | Finding: Up to now, this question has largely been investigated in people who not only have elevated cholesterol levels, but also already suffer from cardiovascular disease. Do these individuals receive additional cholesterol-lowering medications in addition to

claim_topic: Do vaginal suppositories containing the active ingredient imiquimod cause precancerous stages of cervical cancer to recede or disappear?
evidence_text: Claim: Do vaginal suppositories containing the active ingredient imiquimod cause precancerous stages of cervical cancer to recede or disappear? | Finding: In the only study on this subject, treatment was successful in some of those affected. Since the study is flawed and only a few women participated in it, the significance is limited.

claim_topic: Is blue light treatment as effective as UV light or other established therapies for psoriasis?
evidence_text: Claim: Is blue light treatment as effective as UV light or other established therapies for psoriasis? | Finding: We have not been able to find any publication comparing blue light with established treatments (e.g., UV irradiation).

claim_topic: Does frequent consumption of potatoes increase the risk of dying from cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does frequent consumption of potatoes increase the risk of dying from cancer? | Finding: The summarized results of studies to date do not show an increased risk of fatal cancers. They also do not indicate that potatoes reduce life expectancy overall.

claim_topic: Can cancer be detected by dark field analysis (dark field microscopy) of the blood?
evidence_text: Claim: Can cancer be detected by dark field analysis (dark field microscopy) of the blood? | Finding: No cancer diagnosis possible We could not find any evidence for these claims – despite extensive search in several research databases. Although twelve of all participants had cancer, the medical practitioner was only right in three. Even if the small number of participants somewhat restricts the significance, the study shows: A cancer "diagnosis" with the help of dark field analysis is often wrong and would lead to great uncertainty among those affected.

claim_topic: Can dark field analysis indicate other health problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Can dark field analysis indicate other health problems? | Finding: Hardly any studies Questionable is whether other health problems can be identified with the method. Because we could not discover further meaningful studies in which the dark field analysis was compared with recognized diagnostic methods. However, the extent to which the difference is compared to conventional laboratory tests cannot be reliably stated due to numerous problems in the execution of the study.

claim_topic: Does kombucha have a positive effect on health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does kombucha have a positive effect on health? | Finding: There are no studies that have conclusively investigated the effect of kombucha in humans. In addition, it is suspected that in rare cases home-made kombucha can lead to liver disease or dangerous hyperacidity of the blood.

claim_topic: Is graviola an effective and safe treatment for cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Is graviola an effective and safe treatment for cancer? | Finding: Significant studies with healthy or diseased people are missing so far.

claim_topic: Does taking preparations with fenugreek extract improve sex life or satisfaction with it?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking preparations with fenugreek extract improve sex life or satisfaction with it? | Finding: We conclude that no robust conclusions can be drawn from the best available studies to date. We found only two smaller studies with serious methodological flaws. The calculated positive results are not very reliable.

claim_topic: Does disulfiram improve the effectiveness of chemotherapy for cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does disulfiram improve the effectiveness of chemotherapy for cancer? | Finding: The question has been investigated in only two older and small studies in people with advanced cancer. The studies have severe methodological flaws and come to contradictory results.

claim_topic: Can binaural beats relieve stress or anxiety before surgery and medical treatments?
evidence_text: Claim: Can binaural beats relieve stress or anxiety before surgery and medical treatments? | Finding: Previous studies are not conclusive. Moreover, their results contradict each other.

claim_topic: Is a vegan diet healthier than a vegetarian diet?
evidence_text: Claim: Is a vegan diet healthier than a vegetarian diet? | Finding: There is no evidence that veganism has advantages or disadvantages for health. Both a vegetarian and a vegan diet seem to slightly reduce the risk of cancer compared to mixed diets.

claim_topic: Can taking chlorophyll change mouth or body odor?
evidence_text: Claim: Can taking chlorophyll change mouth or body odor? | Finding: There are no meaningful studies of chlorophyll as an antidote to body odor. So the alleged anti-mief effect of chlorophyll has not been seriously researched to this day. Even today, there is no conclusive explanation why chlorophyll should neutralize odors.

claim_topic: Can taking chlorophyll affect the odor of urine in catheter wearers or stool in people with an artificial bowel outlet?
evidence_text: Claim: Can taking chlorophyll affect the odor of urine in catheter wearers or stool in people with an artificial bowel outlet? | Finding: According to the nurses, all participants had unpleasant smells of urine. No desired smell In no study was the odour assessment with chlorophyll tablets better than with placebo tablets. However, the small number of participants and weaknesses in the execution of the study limit the significance of the results – therefore it is unlikely that chlorophyll tablets will influence the smell of urine and stools in individuals with urinary catheter or artificial intestinal output in a desired way.

claim_topic: Is the risk of bacterial or fungal infection comparable when using menstrual cups or pads?
evidence_text: Claim: Is the risk of bacterial or fungal infection comparable when using menstrual cups or pads? | Finding: Our statement is based on a solid single study. Further studies may provide even more clarity in the future.

claim_topic: Laboratory experiments indicate that leoligin and other substances from edelweiss have a medicinal effect. However, this has not been researched in humans.
evidence_text: Claim: Laboratory experiments indicate that leoligin and other substances from edelweiss have a medicinal effect. However, this has not been researched in humans. | Finding: To date, no research has been conducted to determine whether compounds from edelweiss are effective and safe in humans.

claim_topic: Can a straight bar improve harmless tension and pain in the neck and back?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a straight bar improve harmless tension and pain in the neck and back? | Finding: To date, there have been no studies on the efficacy of straight-arm restraints when the pain was not due to serious illness or injury.

claim_topic: Are ultrasound examinations during pregnancy safe for the health of the child?
evidence_text: Claim: Are ultrasound examinations during pregnancy safe for the health of the child? | Finding: In previous studies, routine ultrasound examinations have shown no adverse effects. There were no differences in size, weight, birth complications or malformations in the neonatal period. Later, there were no differences between more frequently or less frequently "sonicated" children with respect to development or skills such as reading, speech, arithmetic, vision, or hearing. However, deficiencies in the study conduct limit the validity of these results quite severely.

claim_topic: Can oregano oil relieve discomfort or disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Can oregano oil relieve discomfort or disease? | Finding: So far, there are no conclusive studies that have investigated the health-promoting effects of oregano oil. We do not know, for example, whether it helps against infections.

claim_topic: Are Bach flower remedies effective in helping with test anxiety?
evidence_text: Claim: Are Bach flower remedies effective in helping with test anxiety? | Finding: Three small studies indicate that remedies with Bach flowers against test anxiety do not help better than a placebo.

claim_topic: Can capsules with diamine oxidase alleviate or prevent symptoms of histamine intolerance?
evidence_text: Claim: Can capsules with diamine oxidase alleviate or prevent symptoms of histamine intolerance? | Finding: We found only one small study with insufficient power.

claim_topic: Does magnesium help with period pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Does magnesium help with period pain? | Finding: To date, there have been no meaningful studies examining this.

claim_topic: Does cannabis improve symptoms of Parkinson's disease, for example movement disorders?
evidence_text: Claim: Does cannabis improve symptoms of Parkinson's disease, for example movement disorders? | Finding: The question has been investigated in only two small studies of unclear methodological quality. While they do not suggest any positive effects on different movement disorders, one study gives evidence of a small improvement in quality of life.

claim_topic: Is the dietary supplement nattokinase effective and safe as a blood thinner?
evidence_text: Claim: Is the dietary supplement nattokinase effective and safe as a blood thinner? | Finding: We could not find any conclusive studies on this issue. Therefore, it remains unclear whether nattokinase acts as a blood thinner and consequently prevents severe cardiovascular disease. Likewise, we do not know whether taking the enzyme is safe.

claim_topic: Is the Feldenkrais Method effective against pain and tension in the neck, shoulders and back?
evidence_text: Claim: Is the Feldenkrais Method effective against pain and tension in the neck, shoulders and back? | Finding: Studies conducted to date are too untrustworthy to answer this question.

claim_topic: Does an alkaline bath help with neurodermatitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does an alkaline bath help with neurodermatitis? | Finding: To date, there is no meaningful research on this.

claim_topic: Does birch water, also called birch sap, help with health problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Does birch water, also called birch sap, help with health problems? | Finding: So far, there are no studies that have investigated this issue. Therefore, evidence for the effectiveness of birch water is lacking. The side effects have also not been researched.

claim_topic: Is oolong tea an effective way to lose weight?
evidence_text: Claim: Is oolong tea an effective way to lose weight? | Finding: We have not found any studies on the subject. Therefore, we cannot judge whether commercial oolong tea helps overweight people reduce their weight.

claim_topic: Do Waveex and similar products reduce exposure to electromagnetic fields, for example when using a cell phone or smartphone?
evidence_text: Claim: Do Waveex and similar products reduce exposure to electromagnetic fields, for example when using a cell phone or smartphone? | Finding: The alleged active principle of Waveex and other comparable products is not scientifically plausible. We also found no meaningful study that could provide information about a possible effect of the cell phone stickers.

claim_topic: Can ingredients in deodorants like aluminum salts cause breast cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Can ingredients in deodorants like aluminum salts cause breast cancer? | Finding: Whether the long-term use of deodorants can lead to breast cancer has not been sufficiently researched. There is a lack of studies conducted according to strict criteria with people over a longer period of time.

claim_topic: Does the intake of black cumin improve the symptoms of asthma, e.g. shortness of breath?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the intake of black cumin improve the symptoms of asthma, e.g. shortness of breath? | Finding: The question has been investigated in four small studies. Some of them have serious methodological flaws and come to contradictory results.

claim_topic: Do specially trained dogs reliably warn of dangerous hypoglycemia?
evidence_text: Claim: Do specially trained dogs reliably warn of dangerous hypoglycemia? | Finding: There are some positive reports and pilot studies. However, larger, well-done studies are lacking. Therefore, it is not proven whether or which dogs reliably detect and report threatening low blood glucose levels. Also unclear: how often do diabetic alert dogs give false alarms?

claim_topic: Does taking proton pump inhibitors (PPI) increase the risk of bone fractures?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking proton pump inhibitors (PPI) increase the risk of bone fractures? | Finding: The question has been investigated in many observational studies involving a total of around 800,000 people. These show indications that prolonged use of proton pump inhibitors may result in more bone fractures. However, it is not possible to quantify exactly how great the risk of PPI is. Presumably, the likelihood of bone fractures increases with longer use and higher dosage.

claim_topic: Can matrix therapy (also: matrix rhythm therapy) alleviate complaints of muscles and joints?
evidence_text: Claim: Can matrix therapy (also: matrix rhythm therapy) alleviate complaints of muscles and joints? | Finding: Studies conducted to date are too deficient to answer this question.

claim_topic: Can hyposensitization by injections with allergy-causing pollen components help with hay fever?
evidence_text: Claim: Can hyposensitization by injections with allergy-causing pollen components help with hay fever? | Finding: In the case of hay fever, hyposensitization with injections can probably alleviate the symptoms somewhat. However, there is still too little research on how long this effect lasts.

claim_topic: Can hyposensitization by means of drops or tablets administered under the tongue help with hay fever?
evidence_text: Claim: Can hyposensitization by means of drops or tablets administered under the tongue help with hay fever? | Finding: Probably this form of hyposensitization helps to alleviate hay fever symptoms somewhat, but the effect is unlikely to be great.

claim_topic: Do Blushwood berries help against skin cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Do Blushwood berries help against skin cancer? | Finding: An active ingredient (EBC-46, tigilanol tiglate) isolated from blushwood berries is currently being studied. Results of an initial study with people who have cancer have not yet been published. We have not been able to identify studies of an anti-cancer effect of other extracts from the berries that are ingested.

claim_topic: Can relaxation exercises and a reduction in stress slow the progression of glaucoma?
evidence_text: Claim: Can relaxation exercises and a reduction in stress slow the progression of glaucoma? | Finding: Studies to date are too deficient to answer this question.

claim_topic: Can dementia be prevented by years of orange juice consumption?
evidence_text: Claim: Can dementia be prevented by years of orange juice consumption? | Finding: The protective effect of orange juice on mental performance has been investigated in two large studies over several years. However, changes in mental performance are not the same as a dementia diagnosis. In addition: the studies came to different results, and chance findings cannot be ruled out. Therefore, the question cannot be answered.

claim_topic: Can remedies from papaya improve digestion or relieve gastrointestinal discomfort?
evidence_text: Claim: Can remedies from papaya improve digestion or relieve gastrointestinal discomfort? | Finding: Studies to date are too deficient to provide a meaningful answer to this question.

claim_topic: Are kinesiotapes effective for chronic non-specific lower back pain ("low back pain")?
evidence_text: Claim: Are kinesiotapes effective for chronic non-specific lower back pain ("low back pain")? | Finding: The efficacy of kinesiotaping in relation to non-specific chronic low back pain ("low back pain") has been investigated in only a few studies. Overall, the evidence suggests that pain intensity does not decrease with kinesiotapes any more than with a placebo tape; thus, the tapes may not be effective. However, this preliminary finding is not well supported. This is because the best studies currently available do not compare well, most lasted only four weeks, and had few subjects overall.

claim_topic: Does early detection of lung cancer by trained sniffer dogs provide significant benefits to those affected?
evidence_text: Claim: Does early detection of lung cancer by trained sniffer dogs provide significant benefits to those affected? | Finding: Experiments indicate that some dogs can detect lung cancer from human breath samples. But we cannot say whether screening with specially trained dogs provides tangible benefits to those affected, such as preventing deaths or enabling gentler treatment.

claim_topic: Do snoring sprays or gargle solutions help against snoring?
evidence_text: Claim: Do snoring sprays or gargle solutions help against snoring? | Finding: Three smaller studies with methodological flaws come to contradictory conclusions.

claim_topic: Does Maca help with sexual problems such as erectile dysfunction or sexual aversion in men and women?
evidence_text: Claim: Does Maca help with sexual problems such as erectile dysfunction or sexual aversion in men and women? | Finding: Studies to date are too deficient to provide a meaningful answer to this question.

claim_topic: Can glacier milk powder prevent hangover or relieve hangover symptoms?
evidence_text: Claim: Can glacier milk powder prevent hangover or relieve hangover symptoms? | Finding: To date, there are no studies that have investigated this issue. There is no evidence of efficacy; side effects have also not been studied.

claim_topic: Can ingredients from pomegranate lower elevated blood pressure or reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Can ingredients from pomegranate lower elevated blood pressure or reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease? | Finding: Previous studies are poor and not conclusive enough to answer this question.

claim_topic: Does regular consumption of red meat or processed meat products increase the risk of colorectal cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular consumption of red meat or processed meat products increase the risk of colorectal cancer? | Finding: People who regularly eat a lot of red meat or processed meat products such as sausage, ham and bacon are likely to have a slightly higher risk of colorectal cancer than people who eat little meat.

claim_topic: Does stool transplantation help with ulcerative colitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does stool transplantation help with ulcerative colitis? | Finding: In ulcerative colitis, stool transplantation could reduce symptoms for at least 8 weeks. Whether the method also helps in the long term has not been sufficiently researched. We have not found any conclusive studies on Crohn's disease.

claim_topic: Does stool transplantation help in Crohn's disease???
evidence_text: Claim: Does stool transplantation help in Crohn's disease??? | Finding: In ulcerative colitis, stool transplantation could reduce symptoms for at least 8 weeks. Whether the method also helps in the long term has not been sufficiently researched. We have not found any conclusive studies on Crohn's disease.

claim_topic: Can remedies from the iambul tree improve blood glucose control in diabetes or precursors of diabetes ("pre-diabetes")?
evidence_text: Claim: Can remedies from the iambul tree improve blood glucose control in diabetes or precursors of diabetes ("pre-diabetes")? | Finding: We were able to identify four studies that investigated the benefit of preparations from the iambul tree ( Syzygium cumini ) in people with diabetes. Because the studies are very small, had very few participants, and are partially contradictory, no firm conclusions can be drawn.

claim_topic: Does HPV vaccination reduce the risk of cervical cancer in girls?
evidence_text: Claim: Does HPV vaccination reduce the risk of cervical cancer in girls? | Finding: HPV vaccination reduces the risk of abnormal tissue changes (of grade CIN2 and higher) on the cervix, which can later develop into cancer. Thus, the risk of later developing cervical cancer probably also decreases. However, the vaccination does not provide complete protection because it is not effective against all cancer-causing human papilloma viruses (HPV).

claim_topic: Is stool transplantation effective against recurrent Clostridium difficile infections ?
evidence_text: Claim: Is stool transplantation effective against recurrent Clostridium difficile infections ? | Finding: So far, only a few studies have been conducted with humans. These have various shortcomings. Nevertheless, there is evidence that stool transplantation is effective.

claim_topic: Does the juice of the aronia berry help against cystitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the juice of the aronia berry help against cystitis? | Finding: The aronia berry is said to have various positive effects. For example, its juice is said to have a preventive effect against bladder infections. However, we could not find any conclusive studies on this topic.

claim_topic: Is Intermittent Fasting suitable for reducing excess weight as well as a conventional low calorie diet?
evidence_text: Claim: Is Intermittent Fasting suitable for reducing excess weight as well as a conventional low calorie diet? | Finding: Intermittent fasting (also: intermittent fasting) is probably effective for losing weight. In terms of weight reduction, there are probably no clear differences from a conventional diet in which calories are permanently reduced. Both paths can lead to weight reductions that are significant for health. The current assessment is based mainly on studies over a maximum of 12 months with middle-aged women from affluent countries. Long-term effects and adverse effects of intermittent fasting still need to be better studied.

claim_topic: Is the risk for the brain inflammation SSPE as a consequence of measles disease greater than long assumed? That is, out of every 100,000 people infected with measles, does more than one person develop SSPE (subacute sclerosing panencephalitis) later in life?
evidence_text: Claim: Is the risk for the brain inflammation SSPE as a consequence of measles disease greater than long assumed? That is, out of every 100,000 people infected with measles, does more than one person develop SSPE (subacute sclerosing panencephalitis) later in life? | Finding: The risk for the fatal brain infection SSPE appears to be significantly higher than the estimate of one SSPE case per 100,000 measles cases in Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States. To calculate the risk more accurately, more reliable long-term recording of measles infections and SSPE cases would be needed.

claim_topic: Can acupuncture for labor induction trigger the onset of labor?
evidence_text: Claim: Can acupuncture for labor induction trigger the onset of labor? | Finding: The results of previous studies suggest that acupuncture is not effective for induction of labor.

claim_topic: Can switching to a higher fiber diet prevent colorectal cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Can switching to a higher fiber diet prevent colorectal cancer? | Finding: According to previous studies, regular intake of wheat bran or psyllium husks over a period of up to four years does not appear to be able to reduce the risk of colorectal precancer and colorectal cancer. This also applies to a comprehensive change to a high-fiber diet.

claim_topic: Can perineal massage during pregnancy help prevent birth injury in first-time mothers?
evidence_text: Claim: Can perineal massage during pregnancy help prevent birth injury in first-time mothers? | Finding: The study evidence to date shows that perineal birth injuries are likely to be somewhat reduced in the group of women having a baby for the first time. This is due in particular to the fact that fewer perineal incisions were performed. The positive effect could not be shown for women who had already had a vaginal delivery.

claim_topic: Can cancer be effectively treated with vitamin C infusions?
evidence_text: Claim: Can cancer be effectively treated with vitamin C infusions? | Finding: Studies conducted to date are deficient and inconclusive.

claim_topic: Are detox cures good for health?
evidence_text: Claim: Are detox cures good for health? | Finding: The term "detox" is not clearly defined. Therefore, we did not find any studies that investigated a health effect.

claim_topic: Do sweeteners increase the risk of type 2 diabetes or sugar metabolism disorders?
evidence_text: Claim: Do sweeteners increase the risk of type 2 diabetes or sugar metabolism disorders? | Finding: The question has been investigated in several large population studies with long observation periods. Nevertheless, no clear conclusion can be drawn: the best estimates cautiously suggest a small effect. However, it could easily be due to other influences. Another problem is that most of the studies only examined sodas and other beverages containing sweeteners. Reliable information on quantity, sweetener type and foods containing sweeteners is lacking.

claim_topic: Does flu vaccination reduce the likelihood of getting the flu (influenza)?
evidence_text: Claim: Does flu vaccination reduce the likelihood of getting the flu (influenza)? | Finding: Flu vaccination is likely to protect adults from influenza. In studies on this, 2.3 percent of participants fell ill without vaccination. With vaccination, the figure was 0.9 percent.

claim_topic: Can therapy with the radioactive gas radon noticeably alleviate pain in rheumatism-related joint inflammation (rheumatoid arthritis)?
evidence_text: Claim: Can therapy with the radioactive gas radon noticeably alleviate pain in rheumatism-related joint inflammation (rheumatoid arthritis)? | Finding: In two small studies, a course of radon therapy relieved pain so slightly within six months that the effect was probably not noticeable.

claim_topic: Does frankincense help with painful joint wear (osteoarthritis)?
evidence_text: Claim: Does frankincense help with painful joint wear (osteoarthritis)? | Finding: Taking frankincense capsules may improve joint pain somewhat. However, this still needs to be confirmed by larger, better conducted studies.

claim_topic: Does the extract of the plant Salacia reticulata in combination with vitamin D ("Exadipin") help to lose weight?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the extract of the plant Salacia reticulata in combination with vitamin D ("Exadipin") help to lose weight? | Finding: There are no conclusive studies that have investigated this effect.

claim_topic: Does yoga reduce the impairment in everyday life caused by persistent (chronic) back pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Does yoga reduce the impairment in everyday life caused by persistent (chronic) back pain? | Finding: With yoga, after six months, sufferers are likely to feel somewhat less affected by their back pain and be able to "function" better in everyday life. However, it seems that the pain itself is not noticeably weakened by the yoga sessions.

claim_topic: Does yoga alleviate the severity of persistent back pain???
evidence_text: Claim: Does yoga alleviate the severity of persistent back pain??? | Finding: With yoga, after six months, sufferers are likely to feel somewhat less affected by their back pain and be able to "function" better in everyday life. However, it seems that the pain itself is not noticeably weakened by the yoga sessions.

claim_topic: Do laughter yoga or laughter therapy have positive health effects?
evidence_text: Claim: Do laughter yoga or laughter therapy have positive health effects? | Finding: There are some studies on the subject. But these are unfortunately not conclusive. After evaluating five smaller studies, we can therefore neither speak for nor against the existence of a positive health effect of laughter yoga or laughter therapy.

claim_topic: Can a height-adjustable desk reduce sitting time in the office?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a height-adjustable desk reduce sitting time in the office? | Finding: There is evidence that people with height-adjustable desks could reduce sitting by about 100 minutes per workday in the short term. Whether the effect lasts in the long term has not been studied. We have separately researched the extent to which a reduction in sitting time can contribute to better health.

claim_topic: Does a diet that includes as many organic foods as possible lower the risk of cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Does a diet that includes as many organic foods as possible lower the risk of cancer? | Finding: To date, only two studies have been published that have explored a possible link between the consumption of organic products and cancer risk. Both publications have methodological flaws. Moreover, they contradict each other: One suggests that people with higher organic consumption are less likely to develop cancer, while the second study found no differences between organic and conventional diets.

claim_topic: Does cinnamon lower blood sugar levels in diabetes?
evidence_text: Claim: Does cinnamon lower blood sugar levels in diabetes? | Finding: The pooled results of studies to date indicate that cinnamon is unlikely to affect blood glucose levels in diabetic patients.

claim_topic: Does sitting for long periods shorten the lifespan?
evidence_text: Claim: Does sitting for long periods shorten the lifespan? | Finding: According to the summarized results of previous studies, people live shorter if they sit for nine hours or per day. evidence_text: Claim: Does taking probiotics facilitate weight loss to any significant degree? | Finding: The question has been investigated in a large number of studies. claim_topic: Does the full moon have a negative effect on sleep duration?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the full moon have a negative effect on sleep duration? | Finding: Some studies can be found that have investigated the influence of the moon on sleep. evidence_text: Claim: Are amla supplements effective and safe in lowering high cholesterol? | Finding: There are some studies with human test subjects. evidence_text: Claim: Are there differences in hair removal effectiveness between IPL and diode laser? | Finding: There may be no difference between hair reduction with diode laser and IPL. More long-term research on this important topic is definitely needed. Current knowledge is by no means well established, and reliable evidence of a cause-and-effect relationship between highly processed food and cancer is lacking. The possible underlying mechanism is unknown.

claim_topic: Do amalgam fillings affect the mental development of school children compared to plastic dental fillings?
evidence_text: Claim: Do amalgam fillings affect the mental development of school children compared to plastic dental fillings? | Finding: Children who receive at least one amalgam filling between the ages of six and ten have slightly more mercury in their bodies than their peers with plastic fillings. Little research has been done on the possible effects of amalgam fillings on children under the age of six and, in the case of pregnant women, on their unborn offspring. Whether there are other health effects has hardly been researched so far.

evidence_text: Claim: Does a legal smoking ban reduce the likelihood of cardiovascular disease in nonsmokers? | Finding: A legal smoking ban is likely to reduce the number of cardiovascular diseases and emergencies in the population as a whole. Mortality is also likely to decrease.

claim_topic: Do pregnant women who take vitamin D have a lower risk of preterm birth?
evidence_text: Claim: Do pregnant women who take vitamin D have a lower risk of preterm birth? | Finding: Some studies with few participants suggest that taking vitamin D during pregnancy may reduce the risk of preterm birth. However, it seems to be just the opposite when pregnant women swallow vitamin D together with calcium. At least in one study, the risk of preterm birth increased in this case. The cause was not clear. Overall, many questions remain open; the study situation is not satisfactory enough to recommend vitamin D intake in principle for all pregnant women on this basis.

evidence_text: Claim: Does aromatherapy have a calming effect on agitation and aggression typical of dementia? | Finding: Based on the state of studies, it is largely unclear whether aromatherapy can help patients with dementia. With lavender aromatherapy, on the other hand, a certain tendency has emerged: it does not seem to help against agitation and aggression - both typical accompanying symptoms of dementia.

claim_topic: Does quitting smoking prolong life?
evidence_text: Claim: Does quitting smoking prolong life? | Finding: Quitting smoking is likely to reduce the risk of premature death. claim_topic: Does eating eggs increase the risk of cardiovascular disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Does eating eggs increase the risk of cardiovascular disease? | Finding: In healthy adults, the risk of cardiovascular disease is not likely to increase if they consume up to five chicken eggs per week as part of a balanced diet. claim_topic: Does oseltamivir (brand name "Tamiflu") reduce the severity and duration of influenza in otherwise healthy adults?
evidence_text: Claim: Does oseltamivir (brand name "Tamiflu") reduce the severity and duration of influenza in otherwise healthy adults? | Finding: Oseltamivir could reduce the duration of influenza ("real flu") by about half a day in otherwise healthy adults. It has not been proven that complications can be prevented by Tamiflu. Whether influenza patients are less contagious due to Tamiflu is unclear.

claim_topic: Is active surveillance ("active surveillance") of patients with low-risk prostate cancer associated with increased prostate cancer mortality risk in the long term?
evidence_text: Claim: Is active surveillance ("active surveillance") of patients with low-risk prostate cancer associated with increased prostate cancer mortality risk in the long term? | Finding: Relatively good evidence shows that men with low-risk prostate cancer who are regularly monitored under active surveillance and receive treatment only when necessary are less likely to suffer from incontinence and impotence than patients who have undergone surgery or radiation. However, those on active surveillance may develop tumors more often and may be more likely to develop metastases. Whether men on active surveillance may be more likely to die from prostate cancer than immediately treated prostate cancer patients is insufficiently studied. However, study results suggest that there is no serious difference in life expectancy between the two strategies.

claim_topic: Does Active Surveillance reduce the likelihood of becoming impotent or incontinence, i.e. unintentional urine leakage ??
evidence_text: Claim: Does Active Surveillance reduce the likelihood of becoming impotent or incontinence, i.e. unintentional urine leakage ?? | Finding: Relatively good evidence shows that men with low-risk prostate cancer who are regularly monitored under active surveillance and receive treatment only when necessary are less likely to suffer from incontinence and impotence than patients who have undergone surgery or radiation. However, those on active surveillance may develop tumors more often and may be more likely to develop metastases. Whether men on active surveillance may be more likely to die from prostate cancer than immediately treated prostate cancer patients is insufficiently studied. However, study results suggest that there is no serious difference in life expectancy between the two strategies.

claim_topic: Do extracts of prickly pear (Opuntia ficus-indica) help with hangover symptoms after alcohol consumption?
evidence_text: Claim: Do extracts of prickly pear (Opuntia ficus-indica) help with hangover symptoms after alcohol consumption? | Finding: To date, there have been few studies investigating efficacy of prickly pear extracts after alcohol consumption.

claim_topic: Do statins help older people suffering from cardiovascular disease to live longer? Do they reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke?
evidence_text: Claim: Do statins help older people suffering from cardiovascular disease to live longer? Do they reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke? | Finding: People with cardiovascular disease who do not take a statin die earlier. Without statins, heart attacks and strokes are also more likely to occur. This has not been studied in people aged 75 and older who do not yet have any pronounced cardiovascular disease, but only risk factors. It is therefore unclear whether they benefit from starting statin treatment.

claim_topic: Is Traumeel gel or ointment effective for sports injuries such as sprains, bruises and strains?
evidence_text: Claim: Is Traumeel gel or ointment effective for sports injuries such as sprains, bruises and strains? | Finding: The studies conducted so far are not sufficient to confirm the effectiveness of Traumeel in sports injuries.

claim_topic: Are weather phenomena and weather changes triggers of migraine attacks?
evidence_text: Claim: Are weather phenomena and weather changes triggers of migraine attacks? | Finding: In sum, the topic is still not well researched. This could be due to the difficulty of providing evidence for what may be a very individual phenomenon.

claim_topic: Does artichoke preparation help with gastrointestinal problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Does artichoke preparation help with gastrointestinal problems? | Finding: There are some studies on the subject. However, the quality of these studies is very poor. There is a lack of solid evidence for the positive results, for example because the subjects were not blinded or compared with control groups. The role played by pharmaceutical companies in financing and conducting the studies also points to possible bias effects.

claim_topic: Does prickly pear help with long-term weight loss?
evidence_text: Claim: Does prickly pear help with long-term weight loss? | Finding: Based on the study situation, it is unclear whether dietary supplements with prickly pear are supportive in losing weight over a long period of time. They probably do not help to reduce weight in the short term. It is possible that they can help to reduce the body fat percentage and BMI a little. But these effects are small - and probably have little or no impact on the individual. Reliable long-term studies on possible positive effects are lacking. In addition, it is uncertain what undesirable and possibly dangerous side effects may occur as a result of long-term use of prickly pear supplements.

claim_topic: Can turmeric relieve the symptoms of depression?
evidence_text: Claim: Can turmeric relieve the symptoms of depression? | Finding: It is unclear whether turmeric can help with depression. The studies on this question that do exist are only of modest quality.

claim_topic: Do phthalates affect semen quality in men?
evidence_text: Claim: Do phthalates affect semen quality in men? | Finding: In animal studies, some phthalates may promote infertility. Previous research in men suggests that levels of phthalates found in everyday life may reduce the quality of sperm cells in humans. This association is not well established, and it is unclear to what extent it affects fertility. Whether the plasticizers prevent women from becoming pregnant has not yet been investigated in meaningful studies.

claim_topic: Do phthalates reduce the likelihood of pregnancy in women?
evidence_text: Claim: Do phthalates reduce the likelihood of pregnancy in women? | Finding: In animal studies, some phthalates may promote infertility. claim_topic: Does ginseng improve mental performance in healthy individuals and patients with Alzheimer's dementia?
evidence_text: Claim: Does ginseng improve mental performance in healthy individuals and patients with Alzheimer's dementia? | Finding: Studies published so far are too untrustworthy to be able to prove such an effect of ginseng.

claim_topic: Does leaky gut syndrome cause health complaints or diseases?
evidence_text: Claim: Does leaky gut syndrome cause health complaints or diseases? | Finding: There is no clear definition of what leaky gut syndrome is. In fact, the intestinal mucosa is more permeable than usual in some diseases. However, it is unclear whether this is a cause or the consequence of the respective disease.

claim_topic: Does the Alexander Technique help with back pain and neck pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Does the Alexander Technique help with back pain and neck pain? | Finding: Previous studies suggest that the Alexander Technique may help with long-lasting pain in the back and neck. However, further studies need to confirm this. For neck pain, the improvement does not seem to be very great.

claim_topic: Do the components of the Moringa oleifera tree have a positive effect on health?
evidence_text: Claim: Do the components of the Moringa oleifera tree have a positive effect on health? | Finding: No well-conducted studies can be found that demonstrate any health benefits from extracts of the Moringa tree. Also, possible side effects of the plant preparations and any health effects during pregnancy and lactation are not well studied.

claim_topic: Does an extract from the root of the Cape geranium (Pelargonium sidoides, Umckaloabo) work against bronchitis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does an extract from the root of the Cape geranium (Pelargonium sidoides, Umckaloabo) work against bronchitis? | Finding: There is evidence of a possible effect in bronchitis. The effectiveness for colds or sinusitis has hardly been researched in reliable studies. It is therefore still an open question whether substances from Cape pelargonium can favorably influence colds and sinusitis.

claim_topic: Does taking DHEA have an anti-aging effect by increasing the physical and mental well-being of older people?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking DHEA have an anti-aging effect by increasing the physical and mental well-being of older people? | Finding: Previous studies show that well-being of body and soul is unlikely to change when older people take DHEA. The same applies to memory and sexual life. Whether DHEA prolongs life or improves health in old age has not yet been scientifically studied.

claim_topic: Can the proper use of fluoride toothpaste cause serious long-term health problems?
evidence_text: Claim: Can the proper use of fluoride toothpaste cause serious long-term health problems? | Finding: The reduction of caries risk by fluoride-containing toothpaste is fairly well proven, especially for children and adolescents. Serious side effects have not been observed in studies to date when used properly. In children up to the age of about eight, regular swallowing of fluoride toothpaste can lead to mild dental fluorosis. However, this is not harmful to health. Long-term health problems are not known to date.

claim_topic: Does fluoride toothpaste prevent tooth decay?

claim_topic: Do products with the tropical fruit mangosteen promote health?
evidence_text: Claim: Do products with the tropical fruit mangosteen promote health? | Finding: One study has investigated whether a drink containing mangosteen juice alleviates fatigue during exercise. Three other studies have investigated dietary supplements with extracts from the mangosteen for weight loss. However, none of these studies can demonstrate a positive effect.

claim_topic: Are topical agents containing acids and oils, such as Excilor and Nailner, effective for nail fungus?
evidence_text: Claim: Are topical agents containing acids and oils, such as Excilor and Nailner, effective for nail fungus? | Finding: To date, there have been only a few studies dealing with the ingredients of such agents. These are of too poor quality to be able to make a statement on efficacy or inefficacy.

claim_topic: Can weight loss programs reduce obesity in children and adolescents?
evidence_text: Claim: Can weight loss programs reduce obesity in children and adolescents? | Finding: Studies to date suggest that weight-loss programs involving diet, exercise or behavioral therapy - or a combination of these - can somewhat reduce obesity in children and adolescents. At least in adolescents, they are also likely to improve quality of life. Whether the programs also have a long-term effect, however, has hardly been studied.

claim_topic: Does valerian help with sleep disorders?
evidence_text: Claim: Does valerian help with sleep disorders? | Finding: Valerian is popular. However, studies have so far failed to provide good evidence of its effectiveness against sleep disorders.

claim_topic: Is milk thistle extract an effective treatment for liver disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Is milk thistle extract an effective treatment for liver disease? | Finding: Previous studies on this have been poorly conducted and are therefore not conclusive enough. Whether milk thistle can improve liver disease due to alcohol abuse or hepatitis B or C is unclear.

claim_topic: Do dietary supplements with amino acids and proteins help against muscle atrophy in old age (sarcopenia)?
evidence_text: Claim: Do dietary supplements with amino acids and proteins help against muscle atrophy in old age (sarcopenia)? | Finding: There is scattered evidence that taking amino acids can help people with sarcopenia. However, more well-done studies are needed. This is the only way to reliably assess whether the alleged effect actually exists, how large it is, and what the ideal dose, optimal duration of intake, and possible side effects are.

claim_topic: Can music therapy help people affected by stroke learn to walk normally again?
evidence_text: Claim: Can music therapy help people affected by stroke learn to walk normally again? | Finding: Music therapy that works with rhythm can probably help people with a walking disorder to walk faster again and take larger steps. It is still unclear whether music therapy after a stroke can also help with problems with speech, limited movement of the arms, hands and fingers, difficulties with memory or attention, or depression.

claim_topic: Does plant or animal protein have an influence on lifespan?
evidence_text: Claim: Does plant or animal protein have an influence on lifespan? | Finding: It is possible that vegetable protein and animal protein from eggs, poultry and fish have a more favorable effect on lifespan than proteins from red meat. However, it is unclear how strong this possible effect is or in which groups of people it unfolds.

claim_topic: Does chicken soup help with colds?
evidence_text: Claim: Does chicken soup help with colds? | Finding: So far, this has only been investigated in laboratory experiments. Studies on efficacy in humans are missing so far. Therefore, we can not judge whether chicken soup is helpful for colds.

claim_topic: Do herbal remedies containing an extract of Chinese tragacanth root, such as Lectranal or Allvent, help against allergies?
evidence_text: Claim: Do herbal remedies containing an extract of Chinese tragacanth root, such as Lectranal or Allvent, help against allergies? | Finding: So far, there is only one study with a few participants, and the results are not particularly convincing.

claim_topic: Does alkaline water keep you healthy or can it prevent disease?
evidence_text: Claim: Does alkaline water keep you healthy or can it prevent disease? | Finding: It is unclear whether alkaline water can promote health or prevent disease in healthy adults. Well-done studies on the subject are lacking. Large effects from alkaline drinking water are not likely.

claim_topic: Do remedies with hops or valerian help with anxiety disorders?
evidence_text: Claim: Do remedies with hops or valerian help with anxiety disorders? | Finding: The results of previous studies are not conclusive. The reason is that too few participants were examined in them and the studies were also poorly conducted.

claim_topic: Do extracts of African devil's claw (Harpagophytum procumbens) relieve pain in patients with osteoarthritis?
evidence_text: Claim: Do extracts of African devil's claw (Harpagophytum procumbens) relieve pain in patients with osteoarthritis? | Finding: Currently, there are no well-conducted studies to assess the efficacy of devil's claw extracts in worn joints.

claim_topic: Can probiotics prevent diarrhea after treatment with antibiotics?
evidence_text: Claim: Can probiotics prevent diarrhea after treatment with antibiotics? | Finding: Probiotics can likely reduce the risk of diarrhea after antibiotics.

claim_topic: Is exercise an effective measure to combat depression?
evidence_text: Claim: Is exercise an effective measure to combat depression? | Finding: Current scientific evidence suggests that exercise can alleviate the symptoms of depression. However, the positive effect is only moderately pronounced. Sport does not work any better than current treatments (antidepressants, psychotherapy).

claim_topic: Can a tantrum trigger a heart attack?
evidence_text: Claim: Can a tantrum trigger a heart attack? | Finding: The likelihood of a heart attack may be increased in the hours following an episode of anger. Whether frequent anger over many years leads to a higher risk of heart attack overall has not been proven.

claim_topic: Can capsules with omega-3 fatty acids from fish oil relieve depression?
evidence_text: Claim: Can capsules with omega-3 fatty acids from fish oil relieve depression? | Finding: The studies conducted to date are hardly trustworthy. Their combined results do not suggest that omega-3 fatty acids from fish oil could appreciably alleviate depression. In studies comparing fish oil with drugs for depression, the omega-3 fatty acids appeared to work worse than the drugs.

claim_topic: Does regular consumption of coffee increase the risk of heart disease such as heart attack or stroke?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular consumption of coffee increase the risk of heart disease such as heart attack or stroke? | Finding: Studies of people who are healthy and drink coffee regularly do not appear to show an increased risk of heart attack, stroke or other cardiovascular disease. On the contrary, they even suggest that coffee may reduce the likelihood of these.

claim_topic: Do cesarean babies have a higher risk of becoming overweight later in life?
evidence_text: Claim: Do cesarean babies have a higher risk of becoming overweight later in life? | Finding: There is evidence that birth by cesarean section may slightly increase the risk of obesity later in life. For asthma, allergies and type 1 diabetes, an increase in risk due to a cesarean section is unclear. Overall, it is not yet clear whether there is a direct causal relationship between the type of delivery and the development of diseases in childhood, adolescence and adulthood.

claim_topic: Does the pregnancy hormone hCG help with weight loss?

claim_topic: Does cupping relieve chronic neck and back pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Does cupping relieve chronic neck and back pain? | Finding: Studies to date are of too low quality to provide a meaningful answer.

claim_topic: Can eating broccoli or broccoli sprouts improve gastritis symptoms?
evidence_text: Claim: Can eating broccoli or broccoli sprouts improve gastritis symptoms? | Finding: So far, there is a lack of well-done human studies that would show that eating broccoli or broccoli sprouts can help with gastritis.

claim_topic: Do Schuessler salts work? (alternative spellings: Schuessler salts or Schuessler salts)
evidence_text: Claim: Do Schuessler salts work? (alternative spellings: Schuessler salts or Schuessler salts) | Finding: The concept of Schüßler salts is not scientifically plausible. Moreover, the effectiveness of the alternative medical method has never been investigated in studies.

claim_topic: Does pelvic floor training help women with stress-related urinary incontinence?
evidence_text: Claim: Does pelvic floor training help women with stress-related urinary incontinence? | Finding: Several systematic reviews confirm the effectiveness of pelvic floor muscle training in different groups of patients. Slight doubts exist only because the individual studies use very different methods, which makes an overall evaluation difficult.

claim_topic: Can methadone enhance the effects of chemotherapy or other cancer treatments and help cure cancer?
evidence_text: Claim: Can methadone enhance the effects of chemotherapy or other cancer treatments and help cure cancer? | Finding: So far, this has not been verified in scientific studies.

claim_topic: Can treatment with tea tree oil relieve pimples (acne)?
evidence_text: Claim: Can treatment with tea tree oil relieve pimples (acne)? | Finding: While a small study provides tentative evidence that tea tree oil may help against pimples, only further, well-done studies can provide scientific certainty.

claim_topic: Does sugar consumption impair memory or other mental performance?
evidence_text: Claim: Does sugar consumption impair memory or other mental performance? | Finding: Whether a high-sugar diet impairs mental performance in the long term has not been adequately researched; there is a lack of conclusive studies over a long period of time.

claim_topic: Does extra folic acid in men help prevent birth defects in children?
evidence_text: Claim: Does extra folic acid in men help prevent birth defects in children? | Finding: There is no clinical study on this question in humans. Some laboratory studies show a possible influence of folic acid on sperm quality, but even there the study situation is by no means sufficient. An influence on birth defects has not been investigated.

claim_topic: Does taking ginger reduce nausea and vomiting during pregnancy?
evidence_text: Claim: Does taking ginger reduce nausea and vomiting during pregnancy? | Finding: There are some studies on ginger as a remedy for nausea in early pregnancy, but the results are contradictory. As a remedy for motion sickness, ginger has almost not been studied at all. In a small study against seasickness, ginger partially reduced symptoms, but whether the effect is large enough for people to actually notice it while traveling cannot be said for sure based on this study.

claim_topic: Are electric cigarettes less harmful than tobacco smoking?
evidence_text: Claim: Are electric cigarettes less harmful than tobacco smoking? | Finding: Clinical studies on e-cigarettes are thin on the ground. The ingredients are extremely varied, and their long-term effects are unknown. Only long-term studies will provide certainty.

claim_topic: Does parents licking the pacifier protect children from allergic diseases?
evidence_text: Claim: Does parents licking the pacifier protect children from allergic diseases? | Finding: There is only one study on this issue. However, the results are not conclusive.

claim_topic: Does calcium help with allergy?
evidence_text: Claim: Does calcium help with allergy? | Finding: Whether the preventive intake of calcium helps against different types of allergy has not been investigated in meaningful studies. The available studies either examine participants without allergy, measure only one-time reactions and artificial situations, or do not test effects that actually matter to patients.

claim_topic: Can taking vitamin D relieve chronic pain?
evidence_text: Claim: Can taking vitamin D relieve chronic pain? | Finding: Studies to date are contradictory. They cannot provide a clear indication that vitamin D can alleviate chronic pain; further studies are needed.

claim_topic: Does aloe vera relieve discomfort caused by psoriasis?
evidence_text: Claim: Does aloe vera relieve discomfort caused by psoriasis? | Finding: There is no evidence of efficacy for any of these skin problems. At least partially conclusive studies exist only for psoriasis - but there the results are contradictory.

claim_topic: Does aloe vera help with neurodermatitis, poorly healing or fresh wounds?
evidence_text: Claim: Does aloe vera help with neurodermatitis, poorly healing or fresh wounds? | Finding: There is no evidence of efficacy for any of these skin problems. At least partially conclusive studies exist only for psoriasis - but there the results are contradictory.

claim_topic: Does electromagnetic radiation from cell phone towers cause health problems such as headaches or sleep disorders?
evidence_text: Claim: Does electromagnetic radiation from cell phone towers cause health problems such as headaches or sleep disorders? | Finding: The few studies on electrosensitivity so far tend to indicate that it is not the cell phone masts themselves that affect the health of electrosensitive people. Their complaints such as headaches, sleep disturbances or concentration problems are more likely to be triggered by concerns about cell phone tower radiation. Long-term studies in the field are still lacking.

claim_topic: Can antibiotic-resistant germs from animal husbandry be transferred to humans?
evidence_text: Claim: Can antibiotic-resistant germs from animal husbandry be transferred to humans? | Finding: Whether the use of antibiotics in agricultural animal husbandry could directly harm human health is currently not sufficiently researched. However, studies indicate that transmission of resistant bacterial strains from pigs and co to people who have direct contact with animals in farm animal fattening is possible.

claim_topic: Does regular vitamin D intake lower the risk of cancer in adults?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular vitamin D intake lower the risk of cancer in adults? | Finding: Studies lasting up to seven years and involving a total of around 50,000 participants have been unable to find any effect.

claim_topic: Does regular consumption of ground flaxseed harm health?
evidence_text: Claim: Does regular consumption of ground flaxseed harm health? | Finding: Currently, there are no well-done studies that have investigated whether daily consumption of ground flaxseed over an extended period of time can be detrimental to health.
